Considering the illegibility and uncertainty in ecological safety evaluation, the paper combined fuzzy mathematics and matter-element theory to establish an evaluation model. Finally it developed a case study on Guangzhou city from 1991 to 2007. There is a tendency of gradual improvement in ecological safety of Guangzhou. However, safety conditions during the study period belong to “critically safe” grade, so ecological safety conditions of Guangzhou are unsatisfactory and need to be improved. Fuzzy matter-element theory is scientific, simple, and practical for multi-objective decision-making problems of safety evaluation.

articleTitle: Algorithm of pulse position identification of complex wave form taken by linear CCD sensor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: According to triangulation principle, optical mechanical and electrical structure of the geometrical parameters of the railway over head contact net auto-measuring equipment based on linear CCD sensors is proposed. For abnormal pulse wave form problem caused by each block of air multi-target, it proposed that the signal, in turn, should be done the following: normalization, a differential, quadratic differential, amplitude separation, location search, and gravitational center computation, which can effectively extract pulse position. Practice has proved that the algorithm recognition is reliable, and the extracted pulse position is used to coordinate calculation, whose precision meets the relevant standards.

articleTitle: DSP practical solutions for motor control using DSP-Controller
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The performance of a DSP architecture allows an intelligent approach to reduce the complete system costs of digital motion control applications using cheaper electrical motors, fewer sensors, and smaller sizes of EMI filters. To provide also a cost optimal solution Texas Instruments developed a single chip solution combining the features of a Microcontroller and the performance advantages of a DSP core. This - so called “DSP-Controller” delivers the real-time MIPS and the tightly integrated peripherals to implement optimal control algorithms with no cost penalty. This paper deals with an overview of DSP solutions in digital motor control applications whereby the focus will be the DSP-Controller and its applications. For sensorless control strategies practical example of its implementation and its results were given.

articleTitle: Knowledge-based design of the open-learning process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: According to the OECD classification of knowledge the study focus on the network learning process from the view of knowledge, dissemination intermediary and object. Proposed process-oriented rather than task-oriented open-learning process model and key variables, which Wish to provide ideas to construct open- learning environment.

articleTitle: Research on analysis model of important network information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper mainly studies an intelligent analysis method of important information network by neural network technology, discusses in depth the different ways to take the word of the impact on neural network performance, and presents a method of using compressed matrix compression thesaurus to improve the network performance approach. Finally, the test results of performance of the neural network model are given.

articleTitle: E-commerce applications: Issues and prospects
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: E-commerce applications, with enormous potential in its application, will bring opportunities and challenges to today's international trade. This paper analyzes the status of e-commerce applications, find out the problems in e-commerce application and propose solutions to this problem.

articleTitle: Design of a Computer-supported Ubiquitous Learning system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Computer-supported Ubiquitous Learning (CSUL) systems aim at providing ubiquitous learning resources and support for learners' ubiquitous learning needs, which makes it possible for learners to promote active learning anytime, anyplace, with any device and in any way that learners prefer to. This paper addresses the design framework of a CSUL system, and discusses interaction design, learning devices choice, context-awareness support, and learning service in CSUL.

articleTitle: Permanent Magnet Linear Brushless DC Motor position control system based on single neuron
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In this paper, the method of single neuron PID control for Permanent Magnet Linear Brushless DC Motor(PMLBDCM) is addressed. For the poor performance of the system of anti-disturbance features, a disturbance observer to increase the system robustness of PMLBDCM drive system is designed. As the demonstration of the results, the system robustness of the driver is increased and function of the motor can be more accurate and quicker.

articleTitle: A parallel algorithm for mining association rules
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: There are disadvantages of producing vast candidate items set and correspondence in the traditional parallel algorithms for mining association rules. One comparative efficient parallel algorithm for mining association rules PBFI-Miner is presented. It uses the bit objects to express data and to improve the FP-Tree; and uses parting strategy to achieve near optimal balancing between processors. The processors communicate with bit object groups so that the algorithm efficiency is increased. Experimental result verifies the efficiency of the PBFI-Miner.

articleTitle: Performance analysis for a CDMA network based on statistical algorithms
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Traditional performance analysis aiming at OMC performance data mainly focuses on two aspects: longitudinal comparison of the same network element in different time periods and horizontal comparison of the different network elements in the same time. It's lack of association analysis between performance indexes and in-depth data mining. In this paper, a network performance analysis approach based on correlation analysis and regression analysis is presented which focusing on solving the difficult problem that general diagnosis algorithms can hardly build for CDMA network optimization. Based on the characteristic of performance indexes, the statistical method was introduced to performance optimization. The correlation coefficients and degree of curve fitting were proposed to measure the related degree between performance indexes, which is the foundation of fault diagnosis for engineers. With the practical application to the network optimization, it's proved that the statistical analysis is a novel and efficient tool for performance optimization and fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: The research about information interaction design based on the usability of intelligent product
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Based on the research about the usability concepts, combining the composition of the man-machine interface in the product function realization and the trends in smart product development, I put forward that information interaction is decisive, sum up a typical form of user interface when the product is used for information interaction, and propose the general principles of information interaction design to enhance the usability of product and the developing information interactive design.

articleTitle: Reducing cognitive load in mobile learning: Activity-centered perspectives
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Mobile learning should take into account main features and limitations of learner cognitive architecture. The paper provides a brief overview of cognitive architecture and sources of cognitive load, and analyzes methods for reducing cognitive load, which are participatory design, resource location agents, reducing extraneous cognitive load by interactivity. The paper also discussions the usability of mobile learning. The aim is to transfer learner behavioral activity into cognitive interactivity that generates essential cognitive processing relevant to knowledge construction without increasing non-essential extraneous processing load.

articleTitle: A study on FDI's crowd-out and crowd-in effect on the central region's domestic investment-based on Panel Data Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper make a comprehensive and systematic study of the impact of foreign direct investment on domestic investment in the region. Results show that: For the central six provinces, FDI has caused the crowd-in effect on the domestic investment. However,due to the central region provinces, such as economic and management level differences, leading to FDI on domestic investment to crowd-in and crowd-out effect of differences.

articleTitle: Directed and weighted network models of the inter-bank market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Complex network theory is a powerful tool to study the internal structure and function of the inter-bank market. By using partial information of the inter-bank market, in this paper we use a threshold method to construct directed and weighted network models of the inter-bank market based on the inter-bank lending relationships. Moreover, we can effectively tap the information of network topology properties of inter-bank market, which is helpful to understand the formation mechanism of the inter-bank market network and manage inter-bank contagion risk.

articleTitle: Teaching import and export on partial order relation in Discrete Instructure Mathematics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Given the features that Discrete Instructure Mathematics have Strong theory, the abstract content, and independent Sections, the paper proposed that teaching in expensive, not in too many. The article takes partial order relation as an example to explain how to cayrry on teaching import and export. By studying partial order relation, students' abstract thinking ability get improvement largely. By fine introduction of partial order relation, student are in the hands of the knowledge of Discrete Instructure Mathematics firmly. Thus, students will have a deep impression to the course.

articleTitle: E-local government strategies and SMEs in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: We know that the China Government like governments in many countries recognises the importance of small business in the economic and social structure of the country. In recent years, it has implemented a number of policies, to assist small, medium enterprises (SMEs). In particular the E-Government single access portal for central government and a similar e-local government strategy have been promulgated. It is observed that at the policy formulation stage the nexus between policy and SME outcome is not made explicit and second that the monitoring of policy is lacking which has potentially negative implications for SMEs. It is suggested that the level of public administrative accountability as it relates to the monitoring of this policy is inadequate and to the extent that this observation is generalizable SMEs may not be reaping the gains that could be achieved.

articleTitle: The research and realization of Circular interpolation track based on the Point-to-point comparison method of CNC in Scilab
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Interpolation arithmetic is the core of NC software. This paper takes the Point-to-point comparison method of Circular interpolation as an example, searches its arithmetic, realizes the dynamic simulation of different quadrant Circular interpolation process based on Scilab, and contributes to increase the understanding.

articleTitle: A DTD-based query optimization scheme on XQuery
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: XML has become a standard for data description and exchange through Internet. There have appeared several methods to inquire about XML documents. In this paper, an optimized XQuery query scheme based on DTD is suggested. The scheme makes use of structure information in DTD corresponding to XML documents. In the scheme, the query pretreatment is carried out to obtain the possible path sets. In the course of doing so, the redundant nodes are filtered so that the quantity of linked nodes is reduced. Thus, the XQuery inquiry is optimized through this scheme effectively.

articleTitle: Researches about auxiliary decision support of component library based on decision-tree classification
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In order to break through the limitation of auxiliary decision support of the traditional component library management system, we propose a method which apply data mining technique to the component library management system. Therefore, an application model is built which applies the decision-tree-based classification method to component library management system. Finally, the feasibility and validity of the model have been verified through an experiment.

articleTitle: The plight of China to construct e-government and its path selection
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: E-government is a requirement and key part for governments to develop information, and a realistic choice to improve government efficiency. The government, promoting its management capabilities and service levels through the e-government, can provide the enterprises and public with extensive and convenient information and service; In turn, by means of e-government, the public can be more widespread participation in government decision-making and management and supervision of government action to promote the government in the lawful administration. The paper, analyzing from the connotation of e-government, discusses the reality of our plight to construct e-government, and further puts forward countermeasures and proposals to construct our e-government from three aspects: transform our concept, raise awareness and develop practical development planning.

articleTitle: Routing algorithm simulation of the patient monitoring system based on ZigBee
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In order to better the poor validity of routing protocol and control overhead of the patient monitoring system based on ZigBee, comparing and analysing of two kinds of DSR and AODV routing algorithm, and using OPNET simulation tool for the performance of AODV routing protocol simulation. Making simulation about AODV routing protocol for the transmission delay, RREQ send the number, send traffic and receive traffic, route discovery time, each path, the average number of hops parameters, simulation results show that, AODV routing protocol performance, relatively stable, that is, AODV network routing protocols for ZigBee-based patient monitoring system.

articleTitle: Practice of the innovation pattern of task-driving Teaching method based on Blog in the Teaching of 〈Java Programming〉
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Task-driving Teaching design is one of Teaching method based on the theory of constructivism. How to organize the process is the key of obtaining good teaching effects. In this paper, with introducing the task-driving method in the teaching, taking the Java Program Design Course for example, dividing the Assignment into Closed Assignment, Semi-open Assignment and Open Assignment,it discussed definitely the practice processes on the Blog using Task-driving Teaching design. That's to say “Assignment as Vector-Teacher as Guider-Student as principal.”

articleTitle: Research on building an online community
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper takes a conversational perspective on the issue of building an online community. Through the use of “sticky” relevant dynamic content members can login to the portal. The author descried the purpose of this online community portal is to offer a powerful tool to enhance collaboration between people who share a common interest. This paper will cover how correct navigation can provide easy access to this content. This paper will furthermore discuss how correct layout of information is an important factor. Second, the paper provides some tools to help the user get the gathering place communicate with each other. These tools bring our site some functions. In conclusion this paper stated ideas are integrated into a portal the chances that members will value the portal as a key place to gain / contribute / collaborate information will be achieved.

articleTitle: Research on China's telecommunications industry's CRM system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The Telecommunications industry is facing a series of changes in business environment and the pattern of the market. In the new situation of the 21st century, the customer resources has became the most important resources in the market competition, every company make the customer resources as the focus in the competition. The Telecommunication industry must focus on the training of the core competitiveness. The most important point of the CRM is to remain the customer relationship in the best condition. This article is based on the idea of customer relationship management. Combining the characteristics of the telecommunications industry itself, the article highlights the need for the telecommunication enterprise to implement the CRM management. This paper offers the strategy of the implement of CRM in the telecommunication industry.

articleTitle: An interconnection network RPn(k) and its properties
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Petersen graph has good performance in parallel and distributed computation because of its properties such as short diameter and regularity. Based on the simple scalable properties of ring and the short network diameter of Petersen graph, a new interconnection network RP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>(k) is proposed and the properties of the RP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>(k) are analyzed. It is proved that RP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>(k) not only has good regularity and extensibility, but also has shorter diameter and smaller construction costs than the RP(k) network. Additionally, The conditions satisfying that the network diameter of RP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>(k) are better than those of 2D Torus are presented.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the P2P streaming media's structure based on structure-entropy model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In P2P streaming media networks, users are mostly concerned about how to make full use of node resources, reduce the node startup delay, and ensure the continuity of broadcast media. The evaluation for structure of the P2P streaming media however, has largely been ignored. This paper will firstly, analyze the typical structure of the P2P streaming media system, then propose the methods to evaluate the P2P streaming media architecture which is based on structural entropy and from system Information Flow. The method adopts timeline/ss and quality of the P2P streaming media networks to give the evaluation of the system. Finally as an example, the paper makes use of this calculation model to analyze, verify, and give the evaluation for two streaming media systems.

articleTitle: Document electronic seal system based on digital watermark and DWT technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Safety and genuineness protection of the documents while traveling over the internet is very crucial. In this paper, a novel watermarking scheme for electronic seal based on discrete wavelet transform (DWT) is proposed. The theory of digital watermark based on DWT for electronic seal is discussed. The watermark signals are considered as a binary sequence embedded to the high (HL and HH) frequency band of the document in DWT domain. The algorithm of how to embed and extract the watermark is shown in the paper. The experimental results demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed scheme, which fulfills the strict requirements of electronic seal and is practicality perfect by means of good balance between transparency and robustness.

articleTitle: Research on the key factors of high-tech enterprises' Innovation management control
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The innovation in the high-tech enterprises is the result of many factors. The empirical analysis of domestic high-tech enterprises shows that organizational motivation, organizational barriers, resources support, supervisor support, team support and autonomy all can impact on task performance and contextual performance in high-tech enterprises, which are key points on innovation management system control. Organizational barriers play a negative role. Therefore, managers of high-tech enterprises should strengthen all kinds of support for employees, and give them autonomy in order to form innovation and competitiveness.

articleTitle: Study on Chinese agricultural E-business and the Value Trust Network solution
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper is based on a preliminary investigation of the current logistical and supply chain issues of China's E-business-transformed agribusiness. It aims to find solutions through practical applications of the Value Trust Network (VTN) model. The literature on this topic is extensive, with E-business being a huge topic of interest. Previous studies have made inclusion of such a study regarding these issues highly useful and valuable. The research involved in this paper, employs both qualitative and quantitative research means in questing of the answers for identified research questions. A focus group study and an internet-based questionnaire survey were adopted to assess the E-business in the agricultural produce wholesale trading market in China. The online questionnaire will be mainly focused on existing companies within China's agribusiness sector.

articleTitle: Empirical study on the relationship between networking and business growth
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Based on network theory, this paper constructed the research framework between networking and business growth, through the analysis of 240 valid questionnaires from the software industry, this paper found that the network strength and network density have a significant role on the company's rapid growth. Then the research findings were discussed and finally presented the limitations of this research and possible future research direction.

articleTitle: The fine-grained realization of role-based access control
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Role-based access control is now recognized as an effective way to solve large-scale enterprises uniform resource access control, It is basically meet the security requirements of the traditional closed system, With the constant expansion of the system, the RBAC model used in traditional web application has been seriously hampered the expansion of the system and improvement of the performance in the retrieval efficiency, permissions maintenance and other aspects, and in SOA model, it was difficult to meet the authorization in the process of different nodes and systems to request services and share resources with each other. To solve the above problems, Using REST-style architecture, Based on Struts 2 interceptors to implement a fine-grained role-based access control, The implementations have good flexibility and scalability.

articleTitle: The influential factors of SMS usage among youth: an exploratory study to Western exchanging students in Asia
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This research is related to investigation of the reason why youth use short message service (SMS) by conducting intensive in-depth interviews during 2008 to 2009. It found that affordability, convenience, flexibility, indirectness, recreation, and certainty are the major reasons to use SMS among Western exchanging students who study in Asia. Cultural phenomenon, like attachment, happiness, attitude, and so on, due to SMS usage is another highlight to follow. Furthermore, a conceptual model is initially introduced after summarizing the research conclusion.

articleTitle: Construction of a Theme Virtual Learning Community based on Web3D
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Virtual Learning Community provides a learning environment, which break through the constraints of time space in study. However, it still has the problem like lack of the virtual learning community participation and the life experience degrees etc. Currently, to construct a Web3D-based virtual learning community performs its feasibility. In this paper, through literature analyzes, it describes the weaknesses of the two-dimensional virtual learning communities, takes full advantage of key technologies of Web2.0, including the high-end technology such as communication, collaboration, and 3D etc., and then constructs a web3D-based virtual learning community system. To a certain extent, it will improve the recent deficiencies of the majority of the virtual learning community.

articleTitle: Research on finite element modeling technique of precision forming simulation for complex precision forging part
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper discusses the key technique of finite element modeling for complex precision forging part, which includes geometrical modeling, element type selecting, element meshing and remeshing, material model selecting, friction model definition and contact problem, In addition, the particular application of complex precision forging part in precision forming finite element modeling was shown combined with Hooke's Joint. Finally the main problems being studied subsequently of the finite element modeling for complex precision forging part were also presented.

articleTitle: A multi-Agent based legacy information system integration strategy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In order to integrate legacy system effectively, a multi-Agent based integration model is proposed. In the integration model, every legacy system is encapsulated as Agent and these Agents can communication with SOAP message, at the same time, we can integrate all Agents distributed in different domains based on the integration goal. Due to adoption of wrapping technology for legacy system, original security and stability of legacy system are guaranteed in the integration platform. Finally, the validity and practicability of the integration technology are verified through the application in the establishment of computer information integration platform for TE process.

articleTitle: E-business online payment and credit card industry development in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The research pointed out the trend that e-business online payment is growing with the prospering development of credit card industry in China. The reasons why Chinese consumers prefer online payment and why the credit card industry development is important to online payment were analyzed. The pros and cons of credit card online payment was also discussed with some followed suggestions.

articleTitle: Study on digital instructional resources sharing platform for E-learning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: With the increasing popularity of E-learning, the digital instructional resources in school become more and more diverse. Due to the lack of sharing platform, a series of problems appear such as low resource utilization. Through introducing the current situation of digital instructional resources sharing, this paper builds a sharing platform and analyses the module of it, to perfect the construction of the sharing platform of digital teaching resources, and improve the efficiency of e-learning.

articleTitle: An engineering design of a social system in a digital age
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: A new political system is proposed for the Chinese society as an alternative to the current system for academic study purpose. A country is similar to a big engineering system. For the system to achieve maximum efficiency and to operate smoothly, components such as culture, history, economy and international environments as well as available technologies must be carefully coordinated. The need of China's political reform is not the focus here, rather, the article emphasizes what would the reformed system look like and how would the transition happen. The cost of the transition to the new political system is numerically analyzed. The stabilities of the current and proposed political systems are compared. A democratic and clean government can be achieved by the new political system conceptually.

articleTitle: Study on M-learning mode in the whole process supervision of location, independent, exploration and mutual aid
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: M-1earning is a practice to promote learning by using mobile technology. It is also a new stage in informatization learning. Nowadays, the learning contents and learning methods of M-learning are paid no attention, and the mode of M-learning cannot be studied either. On the base of the discussion of the characteristics and normal operation schemes of M-learning, the feasibility of its application in modern education is analyzed in the paper. Meanwhile, M-learning mode in the whole process supervision of location, independent, exploration and mutual aid mobile learning is constructed. In the mode, M-learning can be supervise in the whole process to promote the information technology to develop its good effects for learning. The goal to propose the M-learning mode is to provide guidance for learners. It operates simply and has some guiding significance.

articleTitle: Case study and the framework of LAN based on ISDN
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: With the development of network technology, ISDN (Integrated Services Digital Network) subjected to ADSL (Asymmetric Digital Subscriber Line) a great impact, the potential of it is fully excavated to reintegration within next-generation network by network operators, has shown outstanding advantages in the framework of LAN, the intranet of Zhe Jiang Normal University as an example to illustrate in this paper.

articleTitle: The digital learning resource design art and its evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: To improve and scientifically evaluate the artistic quality of digital learning resources design, this paper uses qualitative analysis combining quantitative research method to analyze the artistic factors of digital learning resources design, and provides evaluation methods and steps. This is a deepening understanding on digital learning resources design art, and also a reference for its quantitative evaluation and improvement.

articleTitle: Discussion on quality evaluation of tourism land
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: With the rapid development of tourism, the coverage of tourism land and the required land types have been expanding continuously. And the land quality is closely related to the quality of planning and design of the scenic spots. Therefore, the present study constructs an evaluation system of tourism land quality, and conducts a land quality evaluation based on evaluation system of tourism land quality.

articleTitle: Strong convergence theorems of the CQ method for asymptotically non-expansive semigroups
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In this paper motivated by the T. Suzuki. I show that strongly convergence theorems for asymptotically nonexpansive semigroups in Hilbert spaces. The results presented extend and improve the corresponding results of Kazuhide Nakajo and Wataru Takahashi.

articleTitle: E-commerce security model construction based on Mobile Agent
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: With the development of network technology and the extensive use of e-commerce, the traditional e-commerce processes and its supported technology were faced with challenges. As a new distributed computing model, Mobile Agent technology has many personal advantages and features such as reducing network load, without continuous network connections and easy to support services, having been hailed as the next generation of network computing note by many scholars. However, the mobility of Mobile Agent brings a lot of uncertainty, in order to enable Mobile Agent successfully applied to e-commerce, we must solve the Mobile Agent's security issues. Mobile Agent System based on the analysis of security issues, proposes a mobile agent-based security policy based on trusted third party, on this basis, builds e-commerce security model.

articleTitle: Channel assignment strategy based on hierarchy interference model in cognitive wireless mesh networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In this paper, a new channel assignment strategy based on hierarchy interference model for the cognitive wireless mesh networks (CogWMN) is proposed. In order to choose the best path, the strategy first stratifies CogWMN and sets the value of weights according to layers, and then chooses the best channel based on channel hierarchy interference model. The new strategy effectively combines routing and channel assignment methods. By the route to assist in the realization of channel allocation of nodes, the entire network obtains the optimum performance. Simulation results show that compared to the link-based channel allocation algorithm in wireless multi-channel network, the new algorithm has an obvious advantage in the performance of delay and throughput.

articleTitle: Exploration and research of automatic control system based on time inverse
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper has deeply long-term explore and research to the out-of-aluminum process of the electrolytic aluminum production process. It has brought forward Precise control algorithm based on time length inverse control close wind action, efficiently overcame the problem of incapable implement precise out-of-aluminum which lead by forward measurement in the traditional process of a single electro-bath out-of-aluminum. So it has greatly improved the measurement accuracy out-of-aluminum. Through multiple production experiments, it shows that the method used in this paper feasible and safe and effective. This can overcome the traditional nonlinear strong interference and other factors. It has provided an effective protection of energy-saving emission reduction for the enterprise. Further studies can achieve the automation of enterprise energy-saving emission reduction together with Three-optimizing systems which promoted by countries at moment.

articleTitle: Research and practice on the cooperative concealing technology of Trojan horses
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Trojan is a Trojan horse hiding technology, one of the key technologies, directly determine the viability of Trojan horses. This paper describes the current commonly used Trojan horse hiding technology, the traditional implementation method Trojan hidden lack of independence, according to concerted hidden thought, given the four threading model under Windows systems and their specific implementation method to explain the problems encountered in the implementation process and solution approach. In response to the four further threading model is just to restore the initial state of the shortcomings of the passive given extension model. Experiments show that the four threads together more independent thought hidden Trojan horse has a better prospect.

articleTitle: Information asymmetries, financing and distorted investment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Due to information asymmetries good firms or bad firms all finance and invest under some conditions, who prefer equity to debt financing when the NPV of a project is enough low, and prefer debt to equity financing when the NPV of the project is enough high. Financing produces the firms' overinvestment or underinvestment, the probability of which is affected by factors. In special, if the firms only issue debt, then they can avoid overinvestment or underinvestment. Firm assets-in-place and the true NPV of the project being transparent may avoid overinvestment or underinvestment. Furthermore consider dynamic stock financing, it is discovered there are many equilibria in stock financing and distorted investment which are related with different information asymmetries.

articleTitle: A simulation study of the relationship between properties of knowledge and firm innovation performance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Building on previous research, this paper argues that a company's absorptive capacity to improve its innovation performance will depend on sound management of its available outside network knowledge. Consequently, this study develops a research simulation model that links the properties of knowledge obtained from outside network, firm's absorptive capacity and the features of a firm's knowledge network topology to predict innovation performance. We find that the interaction between properties of knowledge, absorptive capacity and network topology has significant, positive effects on firm innovation performance.

articleTitle: Brief analysis of inter prediction in video coding
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Inter prediction creates a prediction model from one or more previously encoded video frames or fields using block-based motion compensation. In this paper, we briefly analyze the inter prediction tools available in the Baseline profile of the h.264 coding standard. Important differences from earlier standards include the support for a range of block sizes (from 16×16 down to 4×4) and fine sub-sample motion vectors (quarter-sample resolution in the luma component).

articleTitle: A monitoring network on highways based on VPN and study of its QOS mechanism
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: An MPLS VPN network structure was proposed to be used in the highway monitoring network to solve the bottleneck drawbacks of the existing network,to improve the network security,and to meet the needs of the highway monitoring network. The labeling process of the network edge MPLS is similar to the classification process of the Diff-Serv model,on the basis of which the model was introduced into the network. Thus,the labeling process was distinguished in accordance with the requirements of different services. QOS was improved then. The simulation results showed that this technology not only met the basic needs of building special road monitoring networks,but improved effectively the performance-price ratio of the routing technology of the network layer,increased the network expansion,and satisfied requirements of the real-time detection and security of the road monitoring network.

articleTitle: Tourist Internet information search motivation: An empirical study of backpackers of university students
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Internet has being increasingly playing an important role in searching tourism information for tourists before making a purchase decision. However, there exit benefits and costs for tourists during Internet information search. The aim of this study is to discuss relationship between tourists' motivation and benefits and risks of Internet information search from information economics. The finding shows that respondents are divided into four groups after cluster analysis was applied on the perceived benefit and risk of backpacking. The name of the four groups is “high-benefit low-risk”, “high-benefit high-risk”, “low-benefit low-risk” and “low-benefit high-risk”. According to a chi-square test, the groups display significant difference in their information search motivation on the Internet.

articleTitle: The design of enterprise VoIP MGC based on MGCP protocol
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The soft-switch is used for enterprise VoIP. Using MGCP protocol designs a kind of MGC (Media Gateway Controller) for enterprise VoIP. Optimizing the MGCP protocol makes it have the amplifying call, group call and all call. The hardware is used DSP chip and we complete software on the chip to realize this kind of MGC. Describe the whole communication process. It is widely used in the enterprises which existing the strong noise, such as oil, chemistry and mine.

articleTitle: Application research of trusted computing platform in electric power information system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of trusted computing with active defense ideas to solve security problem of computer and network system, and trusted computing is believed to be the most likely fundamentally solve the security of computer system. This paper puts forward an application scheme of trusted computing platform being used in electric power information system. According to security requirements of electric power information system, it designs a method of constructing dynamic trust chain based on system management mode (SMM), and makes dynamic measurement to system program and key application, in order to ensure operating system environment integrity and trusty, effectively defenses against malicious code, make great efforts to enhance power information system security defense capabilities.

articleTitle: Web service based information integration approach for chemical process system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In order to integrate chemical process operation system effectively, a web service based system information integration approach is presented in this paper. The application technologies of web service are introduced for chemical process information integration. Besides, the reality steps of information integration are introduced according to the proposed approach functions. Compared to the traditional distributed integration technology, the advances and features of the approach are discussed. A case study of a mini chemical operation platform is used to verify the practicability and validity of proposed information integration approach.

articleTitle: Research on novel architecture of optical network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The transmission of IP packets over WDM technology (IP-over-WDM) is expected to be the basic transmission framework of the next generation network. In this paper, a novel architecture of optical network is presented. The optical network control plane is responsible for tracking the network topology and the state of network resources, and for establishing, removing and maintaining connections. These functions can be achieved using two fundamental protocols-the routing protocol for topology and resource discovery, and the signaling protocol for connection provisioning, maintenance and deletion. Additional protocols may also be used within the optical network control plane. By analysis and study of optical Internet architecture, a novel technology to construct the hybrid model architecture for IP over WDM systems is given and tested. The results show that the hybrid model architecture is efficient.

articleTitle: Optimization of the SATD function in AVS-M
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In this paper, we briefly introduce the AVS-M, show the SATD function definition and the role of it. And then, we optimize the SATD function in AVS-M in four parts: expand cycle, use macro definition to the absolute value calculation, use the C library function instead of macro definition, merger the final step of Hadamard_Transform. Through optimization, coding speed increased from 1.15 frame/sec to 1.32 frame/sec.

articleTitle: LAN-Free backup program design based on SAN
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Since the data's transmission is through the LAN. When we need backup a larger amount of data, backup time window is tight. The network is vulnerable to be congested. In the SAN environment, we can use LAN-Free backup of storage network. In this article, I mainly introduce the design and presentation of LAN-Free backup program.

articleTitle: Application of LOD in collaborative design and information security
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: CAD models are required to transmit through network in many occasions, and the information security must be ensured. A transmission framework depending on progressive mesh is proposed in this paper. The description method level-of-detail (LOD) is introduced, which is a method to reduce the number of polygons for rendering, storage, transmission and following processing by using different-resolution details for the objects in a scene, while ensuring the image quality or geometrical accuracy. By using LOD structure tree, the model with the most appropriate resolution is transmitted automatically according to the bandwidth and the requirement of users. The data volume of transmission is reduced and the resolution is adjusted freely. Further more, by combining Christopher's role-based viewing envelopes for information protection, the information security in collaborative design environment is ensured, and the leakage risk of important data is reduced in the muti-organization cooperation environment.

articleTitle: Network infrastructure and economic growth
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper analyses the effect of network infrastructure imposed on economic growth in China. It also analyses the relationship between network infrastructure and economic growth. And the role Chinese network infrastructure play in economic growth course is discussed in this paper with modified secondary CES Production Function with three factors. Data from 1994 to 2007 in China are utilized and related parameters are selected in accordance with the characteristics of Chinese network infrastructure. The results obtained indicate that it is a general trend to allocate more resources in Chinese network infrastructure industry. Especially, more resources should be allocated to develop and utilize new technology and scarce human resources instead of hardware construction.

Author Keywords: secondary CES production function with three factors

articleTitle: Research and development of Enterprise Informatization Evaluation Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: With the wide use of informatization technologies, how to evaluate the benefits of informatization was becoming the discussing hot spot for enterprises and scholars. Firstly the paper gives the explanation of IE. then based on the review of Enterprise Informatization Evaluation Theory(EIET) both at home and abroad, four phases in the development of EIET: germination, developing, submature and unknown are identified.Then the main theory and method of every phase is discussed from different point of views. Finally the future developing trend is given out.

articleTitle: Research on models and methods of Magnetocardiography
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Magnetocardiography (MCG) is a risk-free and noninvasive technique with significant diagnostic value. The reconstruction of the cardiac sources on MCG data obtainable is an important research in the electrophysiological study. In this paper, we evaluate the classification of the source models and conduction models, and analyze the corresponding methods on estimation of source distribution and conduction tissue modeling. According to these different characteristics of the methods, further studies will be carried out.

articleTitle: Research on thermal environment in room using separated air-conditioning unit by supplying low-temperature air
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Thermal environment and air flow condition in small assembly room at typical summer weather was studied by numerical simulation and experiment. Numerical simulation was based on the indoor zero-equation turbulence model using momentum method and N-point model as boundary condition of air supply opening respectively. It was found that the N-point model at N=3 as inlet boundary condition to simulate louver supply opening with certain angles gives a good simulation result. A method of simulating heat-gain by solar radiation was proposed. It gives considerable comparable temperature gradient above 0.2 m height. Ultimately, the thermal comfort evaluation was given as separated air-conditioning unit supply low temperature air to the room.

articleTitle: Main program flow analysis in AVS-M
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In this paper, we briefly introduce the AVS-M, including its system structure, coding tools, and so on. And then, we analyze in detail the main program flow from three functions: Main(), Encode_I_Frame() and Encode_P_Frame(). The results of the analysis are very important for us to understand the coding of AVS-M.

articleTitle: Talents maintaining strategies of private enterprises based on organizational commitment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Since the 1960s, organizational commitment has been one of the most important fields in Organizational Behavior; especially in recent 20 years, organizational commitment attracted great interest of Human Resources Management researchers, and a lot of valuable literatures were produced. But there was still not enough research on the organizational commitment of China private enterprises. This article describes the relevant theory of organizational commitment and analyzes the restricting factors of organizational commitment of private enterprises. Besides, it puts forwards some measures on how to maintain the talents by improving employees' organizational commitment. The measures include: speeding up the transformation from family management mode to modern enterprise system mode; establishing equitable salary system; improving emotional commitment by strengthening respects and communications with staff; putting emphasis on career management and providing more opportunities and broad space for development; paying attention to enterprise cultural construction and reaching a shared vision to unite and motivate employees.

articleTitle: Research on dynamic component replacement and its formal specification
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In fact, dynamic component replacement is a relatively difficult problem in the practice of software engineering. This paper presents a new approach which based on architecture reflection to achieve the goal of dynamic component replacement. And what's more, through a concrete case study, the process and formal specification of component replacement were detailed illustrated.

articleTitle: The driven that Internet-society impose to the China's reality-society
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: China's reality social, has the specificity of centralize traditions, with no opposition parties and social organizations are not yet ripe. Due to changes in information technology and popularization of Internet users in China, led that the China's network society to be the first scale in the world's network society. According to this article, the features of the network society, such as occult, open nature, interactivity and diversity, have droved powerful public oversight, the formation of civil society, the information openness of Chinese government, and the diversity of the Chinese people's values. Of course, China need a further growth in the network society.

articleTitle: The study on US government aid for financial institutions
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Since 2007 subprime lending crisis, the U.S. government has taken measures to rescue financial institutions to prevent an economic crisis. However, the government has ever taken policies which are constructive ambiguously to resist moral hazard. If the government rescue them all, the U.S. Government's finances are likely to be collapsed and consume more taxpayers' money. The fact that government assistance policy becomes ambiguously constructive would fundamentally reduce the moral hazard of the financial sector to improve the social support and the effectiveness of bail-out policy and sector self-discipline.

articleTitle: Research on resource pre-configuration in GMPLS-based multi-granularity optical networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In this paper, a resource pre-configuration scheme has been introduced into GMPLS-based multi-granularity optical networks. By pre-configuring the resource of multilayer optical networks, the topology can be reconstructed with the number of direct routes increasing, and the performance of routing and forwarding can be optimized. Numerical results of the simulations show the connection establishing time of control plane could be significantly reduced by using resource pre-configuration strategy.

articleTitle: A study on computer aided process integration system design for chemical batch process development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: For meeting the demands of dynamic characteristics and product quality control for chemical batch process, an approach of computer aided process system integration was proposed. The technology of process state monitoring and product quality control were carried out on a kilogram scale laboratory chemical process, micro-plant based on the construction of apparatus hardware and software for integration. The proposed approach and technology were then applied to synthesis process of ethyl p-hydroxyl benzoate. The results prove that the proposed approach and technology are feasible and can be practical in chemical batch process monitoring and product quality controlling.

articleTitle: A conceptual framework of trust in C2C e-commerce: from multi-disciplinary perspectives
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to present a conceptual framework of trust in C2C e-commerce. This paper summarizes some essential qualities, dimensions and models of trust in e-commerce. By literature review, the paper proposes a conceptual framework of trust from multi-disciplinary perspectives, namely, technology, psychology, management, marketing and each includes subdimensions. And due to the importance of long-term relationship in C2C e-commerce, it also builds a model of trust development in C2C e-commerce according to the important factor-time during the formation of trust.

articleTitle: Evaluating IT service quality with influencing factors
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: IT service has been proved important to information system success, so how to evaluate organization's IT service quality has been widely concerned, but former evaluators did not consider the environment factors which may affect the service behavior. In this study, we identify the IT service quality factors according to SERVQUAL then find out the influencing factors according to information system success model. The analytic network process is employed to identify the interdependence between these two groups of elements. The goal of our study is to help enterprise to understand and manage their information system better.

articleTitle: Transfer efficiency of tacit knowledge in knowledge-based enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Tacit knowledge transfer efficiency is key to obtain sustainable competitive advantage for knowledge-based enterprises. This paper constructs tacit knowledge transfer network models for knowledge-based enterprises based on consulting relationships among the staffs, and is given a method to identify core employees based on the network model. It also analyzes the impact of employee demission on the tacit knowledge transfer efficiency. The results show that: the core staff demission has serious effect on tacit knowledge transfer efficiency, while employees random demission has little effect on tacit knowledge transfer efficiency. The results would be helpful for knowledge-based enterprises to identify core employees and manage their staffs.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of network virtual display system in digital products
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The application of virtual reality technology in the network virtual display is described in this paper. Network virtual display system in digital products which is designed mainly based on Virtools, achieves to use the camera as the main display. Its display case verifies the feasibility of the virtual reality technology in the network virtual display, and creates a new product display way.

articleTitle: The design of web 2.0-based teaching management system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This thesis introduces the basic function of web 2.0-based teaching management system and proposes the entire structure design of the system combined with the current situation of teaching management system. The thesis emphatically elaborated the functional module design of this system. The whole system have consummate function, it is very convenient and flexible for application , the contact surface is friendly, all of which provide perfect guarantee for the teaching management. Based on all of these, it foresees its application perspective providing a new way for the teaching management system in the Web 2.0 era.

articleTitle: The research and implementation of color transformation based on matrix transformation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In digital image processing algorithms transform the image of the matrix has a wide range of applications, all of the geometry of the transform, pixel color transform, convolution or transform images they can use the same principle to achieve the transformation matrix. At the same time to avoid the use of a separate matrix for each, respectively, to achieve the effect of code, the use of a particular matrix can be achieved over the past cumbersome and complex algorithms. The paper describes the matrix in the image principle innovativly put forward the BrightnessMatrix, ContrastMatrix.

articleTitle: The realization of Color conversion based on ICC Specification
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The color management technology is the essential technology which is closely linked with the tabletop publication and digital printing. The appropriate color management causes the color of the graph picture to distort slightly in the switching process between the different color spaces. This paper introduces the Specification and the theory of Color Management, and realizes the conversion of the color between the different color spaces.

articleTitle: Dual routing engine architecture in optical networks for path computation and resource optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: With the development of large-scale, multi-region and multi-layer networks, policy and constraint-based path computation is more and more complicated and dynamic routing becomes one of the key issues in GMPLS/ASON networks. Then a routing architecture named PCE is proposed to resolve the aforementioned complicated routing problem. However, as the huge bandwidth requirement emerges, capacity of Tbit/s transmission links and Pbit/s switching are necessary for next generation optical networks. According to the current photonics technology level, the node architecture will be very complicated and of large power consumption. Then how to configure the switching architecture in the node will be very important for the entire network performance. Unit engine (UE) is proposed for the management and configuration of resource in the node. PCE and UE constitute dual routing engine architecture (DRE) in GMPLS/ASON optical networks for path computation and resource optimization. The collaboration of PCE and UE makes it effective to optimize path computation especially under the condition of complex multi-constraints. The functional architecture of DRE is described in detail. Performance of PCE-based path computation in multi-region optical networks is simulated and analyzed.

articleTitle: 2DPCA and IMLDA method of feature extraction for online handwritten Tibetan recognition
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Feature extraction not only extracts the best feature which suits for the pattern classification from the original information, but also reduces the dimensions of sample in great degree. It is the significant part in the area of pattern recognition. Firstly, to extract principal component of Tibetan characters features by 2DPCA method, which can make within-class matrix no longer singularity and, the feature vectors extract from Tibetan characters have relatively high independence. And then, reducing dimension and compressing feature matrix by the IMLDA (image matrix liner discriminate analysis) approach. Finally, the reduction dimensionality Tibetan characters feature is applied to the system of online handwritten Tibetan recognition and the recognition rate increase slightly; meanwhile the paper analyzed the reasons that influence the Tibetan characters recognition.

articleTitle: Research on knowledge-based product rapid design system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: To save product developing time and improve product design quality, an knowledge-based product rapid design system model was put forward. In this paper, a knowledge-based product developing system framework was studied firstly, then some key techniques such as knowledge-based product modeling, knowledge reasoning technique and data base construction were analyzed in this paper. as one of the important part of the rapid design system, the workflow of knowledge reproduction mechanism was described.

articleTitle: Developing platform of Teaching Practical Knowledge Accumulation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Teaching Practical Knowledge Accumulation Platform (TPKAP) has a great significance to both teachers' teaching and growth. The teachers can share their practical knowledge by using individual blogs or Researching Teams which are contained in this platform. And it also establishes the room of teaching video case analysis, electronic documents of the best teaching resources, construction of teaching practical knowledge accumulation community, on-line collaborative lesson-preparation to manage the teaching practical knowledge.

articleTitle: An analysis of building college student learning communities with the use of SNS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper describes practices in a new area. Based on the Social Networking Sites, it studies the effective building of learning communities among university students, and analyzes the social network's ability to effectively build a learning community, to improve college students' learning efficiency, and to promote comprehensive development of students.

articleTitle: Study of fiber-optic smart layer based on FBG sensors
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Based on the virtue of FBG sensors, the design and fabrication of FBG smart layer on the basis of modularization and integration of optical fiber self-diagnosing system were discussed in this paper. The test research results show that the FBG smart layer has little infection to embed smart-layer into composite material, and there is very good linearity relation between the FBG sensors wavelength change and structural strain. Therefore, the FBG smart layer enable to realize the smart health monitoring of composites.

articleTitle: Model and empirical study on factors influence consumers' apparel purchasing intention in the C2C e-commerce market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The consumer-to-consumer (C2C) market has been growing rapidly worldwide. Based on Fishibein's behavioral intention model, this paper investigates the factors influencing consumers' apparel purchasing intention in the C2C e-commerce market. Data for this study were obtained from 400 students of Hunan University. It is found that two attitudinal factors and one social factor significantly influence the consumers' apparel purchasing intention in the C2C e-commerce market. The findings will be helpful for the online market creators to establish practical guidance and improve services for consumers in the C2C e-commerce market.

articleTitle: An application of modified optimal-type elliptic curve blind signature scheme to threshold signature
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Expression of blind message in the optimal-type blind signature scheme was modified so that it can combine with threshold signature, which leads to an effective threshold blind signature scheme based on elliptic curve cryptography, it has the following securities: strong verifiability, nonrepudiation, unforgeability, blindness and robustness, and also takes advantage of characteristics of elliptic curve such as higher security and shorter key, as well as lower computational complexity compared with the previous schemes.

articleTitle: Analysis on evaluation index system of China's modern rural logistics construction based on AHM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The paper analyzed China's modern rural logistics situation and proposed 23 evaluation indexes from seven aspects to establish an evaluation index system of modern rural logistics construction, and finally applied Analytic Hierarchical Model (AHM) to calculate the importance weight of each index in the evaluation system, which provided basis for decision making of building a modern logistics system in rural areas.

articleTitle: Digital modeling and simulation of mechanical oil production system based on virtual Experiment technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: As an important application of the virtual Experiment technology in the oilfield digital construction, based on survey to the production spot of mechanical oil production, the paper carries out the digital modeling and simulation of mechanical oil production system by MATLAB, for further optimizing the improve parameters. Then the simulation analysis to the noncircular gear pumping unit is made as the application of the digital model of mechanical oil production. By comparing with the cylindrical gear drive pumping unit, the conclusion can be drawn that the noncircular gear drive pumping unit can obtain the preferable drive performance and energy saving effects. Moreover, the influence of the moving index on the beam-balanced pumping unit performance is analyzed by optimizing four-bar mechanism geometric parameters.

articleTitle: Finite element simulation of machining of aisi1045 with thermodynamical constitutive equation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In this paper a finite element analysis (FEA) of machining for AISI1045 is presented. In particular, the thermodynamical constitutive equation(T-C-E) in FEA is applied for both workpiece material and tool material. Cutting temperature and tool wear depth are predicted. The comparison between the predicted and experimental cutting temperature and tool wear depth are presented and discussed. The results indicated that a good prediction accuracy of both principal cutting temperature and tool wear depth can be achieved by the method of FEA with thermodynamical constitutive equation.

articleTitle: A pretreatment algorithm for minimizing deterministic finite automata based on state transition symmetry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Characters of state transition graph and corresponding treatments are not considered in current algorithms for minimizing deterministic finite automata. On this problem, a pretreatment algorithm for minimizing deterministic finite automata based on state transition symmetry is put forward. First, the concept that state transition graph symmetry is defined and the equivalence of symmetric states is proved. Second, the pretreatment algorithm is given. In the end, an experiment is carried out and the result shows that this algorithm is fairly efficient.

articleTitle: Ways to maximize customer perceived value in E-commerce age
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: E-commerce is inevitable for an enterprise to survive and develop in the new era of internet, in which the competitive advantage of an enterprise comes from its ability to attract and retain customers. Hence, customer relationship management (CRM) became the core of contemporary enterprise management. On the basis of analyzing customer perceived value (CPV), this paper devoted to explore the relationship between customer perceived value (CPV) and customer relationship management (CRM), the influence of psychological factors on the maximization of customer perceived value (CPV) and the ways to promote and maximize customer perceived value (CPV).

articleTitle: The demand analyze model for Government electronic public services
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Public's demand is the logical prerequisite of Government electronic public services, thus, the essential value of Government electronic public services lies on its sufficient response to public demands. The innovation of this paper is, based on KANO-SPD Matrix, and constructed a new analysis model which could be used as an effective tool for public demand analysis of Government electronic public services.

articleTitle: Study on Liaoning tourism Resources Management Information System based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Tourism resources are the material foundation and prerequisite for tourism development. Only by the scientific and effective management, the reasonable development, planning and utilization can be realized. Tourism Resource Management Information System is a technical system which collects, store, analyze and manage with the support of both hardware and software. It implements the effective management of the tourism resources' scientification, standardization and modernization‥ The present study analyzes and discusses the objectives, database design, content, system structure and its functional characteristics.

articleTitle: Research on formation mechanism of financing structure of the municipal infrastructure projects based on governance structure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Municipal infrastructure projects in accordance with project discrimination theory can be divided into public projects, quasi-public service projects and commercial projects. The paper has analyzed the transaction characteristics of various projects and the governance structure that matches with the patterns described municipal infrastructure projects. What's more, it has set forth the relevance of the governance structure and the financing structure, and on this basis, it has established the formation process model about the financing structure of the municipal infrastructure projects, in the same time, it has pointed out that with the changes of the governance structure, the project financing structure should be in the joint development, which has important practical significance that is to improve and optimize the project financing structure of municipal infrastructure.

articleTitle: The dynamic utilization of educational information resources for teachers professional development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Development of the times put forward higher requirements for teachers, because the level of teachers can directly impact on the levels of education, the best way is to promote the professional development of teachers. This article based on the content of dynamic educational information resources, analysis of the advantages of dynamic education information resources based on educational information resources platform, constructed the use model of dynamic education information resource for the professional development of teachers. In addition, take the network teaching and research of all primary school in Lingwu city for example, to explore the dynamic utilization process of education information resources

articleTitle: Logical AND model of grade approximation operators
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Grade is an important quantitative index, and graded rough set model is an important improved rough set model. This paper is to explore new improved rough set model. Based on logical AND operation of grade approximation operators, this paper proposes logical AND model of grade approximation operators. In the new model, basic structure and properties are obtained, and macroscopic algorithm and structural algorithm are proposed. Finally logical AND model of grade approximation operators is explained by a medical example.

articleTitle: Study on the coordination between technology innovation capability and efficiency: Based on the data of equipment manufacturing industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Taking the seven sectors of equipment manufacturing industry in Jilin Province as research target, this paper builds the same evaluation index system and uses factor analysis rating method to carry out empirical analysis of their technological innovation capacity and efficiency. Based on the results, this paper analyses the coordination between them. The result shows that the coordination between the technical innovation capability and efficiency of seven industries of equipment manufacturing industry in Jilin shows a certain degree of regularity.

articleTitle: The framework of the fourth party mobile integrated payment platform based on cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper presents a framework for the fourth party mobile integrated payment platform based on cloud computing. The purposes of this paper are as follows: to solve the problem of departments segmentation during mobile payment development, to realize the barrier-free communication and integration of mobile payment industrial Chains, to cut down customer attrition cause by low usability of mobile payment. The research method is: analysis the problems of mobile payment, as well as the characteristics of cloud computing, combined with fourth-party payment platform related concepts, proposing a complete framework of the fourth party mobile integrated payment platform based on cloud computing, and describing functions of each part, then concluded the advantage of the fourth party mobile integrated payment platform based on cloud computing.

Author Keywords: The fourth party mobile integrated payment platform

articleTitle: Study on e-marketing model based on resident community
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The E-marketing model in China adopts the international generic model, which develops from WAN into the LAN. This model requires complete support systems, such as modern logistics distribution system, sound credit system and online settlement system. But these systems in China don't satisfy this demand. This paper addresses this problem and proposes a community-based E-marketing model.
