The model includes three development phases, i.e. establishing independent e-business community based on LAN, setting up e-business network based on MAN, establishing e-business network based on WAN. This model can solve the problems of current e-marketing and drive e-marketing development rapidly.

articleTitle: Analysis of BT network based on active measurement
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Peer-to-peer (P2P) systems enable a wide range of important, scalable and reliable services such as file sharing, voice-over-IP (VoIP) and video streaming. And they also generate most traffic in all regions. Excessive P2P traffic can cause significant network management problems because these systems are notoriously greedy with regard to bandwidth consumption. As a result, the ISPs and all network administrators have a mutual interest in shaping, blocking or otherwise limiting P2P traffic. Before doing these, understanding, analyzing and identifying P2P traffic is necessary. In this paper, we inside analyze BitTorrent (BT) traffic with a special modified Vuze client in a stub network. Preliminary results indicate that among all forty-nine BT clients we have detected, the most popular two are μTorrent and Azureus. They have over 50%-86% market share. And about one-third of all clients are the legacy or proprietary client, which have no capacity of supporting the Message Stream Encryption (MSE) protocol. Further, the BT clients relied excessively on trackers, because near half peers' information come from trackers, especially in the beginning of new mission. Moreover, Distributed Hash Table (DHT) did not play the proper role as it is expected. Finally, we unexpectedly find that the most popular used port is still 6881, but it is only 2.24%.

articleTitle: On the predicament of China's e-government planning and its prescription
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In the information age, e-government has become an indispensable tool for good governance, and an information-oriented government has become a key factor for all countries or regions to improve their global competitiveness. E-government construction is a complex project that costs substantial investments and involves multiplex fields, thus it need for sound planning as a basis. On the basis of expatiation on the concept and significances of e-government planning, this paper analyses the main problems and their causes in China's e-government planning, and then propose solutions to these problems. This research may redound to all levels of government in China on developing sound scientific e-government planning.

articleTitle: Digital rights management solutions based on IPTV DRM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: First,this paper introduces the DRM technology, explained how to use IPTV DRM technology to ensure the digital media information throughout the delivery chain that can be control of the security issues. Second, the analysis of the current IPTV content of some of the problems faced, through the use of high-strength 128bit AES algorithm for encryption, private key stored program, digital watermarking, digital signatures and other IPTV DRM technology to ensure content security. Finally, the combination of a PKI architecture and use of X.509 digital certificates and encryption technology, presents a DRM appropriate to the current IPTV networks, programs, and DRM technology in IPTV network, the application has some reference value.

articleTitle: Study on knowledge management system based on MAS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: With approach of the era of knowledge economy, More and more organizations have recognized the importance of efficient enterprise knowledge construction, extraction and management. An efficient knowledge management system is vital to the effective implementation of knowledge management. The paper starts from a discussion of concepts and essence of knowledge management. This is followed by analysis of correlation between MAS and knowledge management. Eventually, a knowledge management system model based on MAS is designed. With the learning mechanism, the accuracy and precision of the KMS modules can be significantly improved.

articleTitle: Scalable video coding based on frequency spectrum in AVS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper presents a new algorithm of scalable video coding base on frequency spectrum. Data partition in MPEG-2 is an early scalable video coding base on spectrum, but it is rough in scalable granularity and low in practicability, while the algorithm proposed in this paper can achieve finer granularity of scalability (9 levels). The algorithm base on frequency spectrum has flexible scalability, low complexity and high efficiency, but it brings a problem of error accumulation through prediction. Because if it only transmits part of DCT coefficients, it makes reference frames of encoder differ from reference frames of decoder which results in error accumulation. This problem is solved by setting references frames in transform region in this paper. AVS-P2 is a new generation of video coding standard with independent intellectual property in China, and it has become a national standard. In this paper, the algorithm of scalable video coding is combined with AVS-P2 and is realized under the framework of AVS-P2. Finally, the algorithm was realized based on the software codec model version rm52j of AVS-P2 and testified the scalable video coding model through several tests.

articleTitle: Research of coal mine equipments management system based on WEBGIS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Based on the WEBGIS theory, the representation models of spatial information and attribute information in coal mine equipments has been created in this paper and further management of coal mine equipments system is established. The representation models can build huge amount of information into GIS databases and then use the databases to conduct unified management of the information so as to make the complex factor squantitative, digital and visual, and spatial information and attribution organically unified as a whole. This method has explored a new pathway for the coal mine digitalization construction.

articleTitle: DSP-based codecs for convolutional codes
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Channel coding is a crucial element to any communication system. Convolutional code is currently the most frequently used code, whose performance is very good. It is the most practical way for channel coding too. However, its hardware is complexity, and computation speed has become an obstacle to improvement of communication speed. This article aims at convolutional coding, in particular the decoding algorithm based on the DSP to achieve (2,1,7) convolutional code encoding and decoding process. Experimental results show that the program not only achieve encoding and decoding process, but also greatly improve signal processing speed.

articleTitle: Networking ties and entrepreneurial learning: An empirical investigation of Chinese enterprisers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Enterprisers learning is a crucial question in the theory of strategic management. How enterprisers can learn effectively has been a crucial and strategic point for the survival and development for the firms. Based on the network theory, this paper studies the effect of enterprisers' social network on enterprisers learning. After analyzing 122 valid samples from Yangtze River, we find that strong ties has a positive and significant effect on the enterprisers' leveraging learning while weak ties has no effect on enterprisers' exploratory learning. And then we discuss the results. Finally, limitations and implications are addressed.

articleTitle: An improved skeletonization algorithm of color cerebral vascular image based on color level set mode
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper presents a continuous skeleton extraction method of color image. This method makes use of a new color level set model based on Bayesian classifier and uses two intermediate functions to extract the topology information and skeleton in HSV space. Not require pre-processing of color images can we get a complex gradient color image skeleton using this method. Because all the parameters are obtained from the analysis, so it avoids artificial intervention. Experiment and analysis can verify the validity and robustness of this method and it is not sensitive to the color gradient and the boundary noise.

articleTitle: The analysis of impact factors for Chinese netizens
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: First , based on studying 23rd Statistical Report on the Internet Development in China released by CNNIC, combined with the statistical analysis of the impact factors (a total of 23 times) about structural characteristics in Chinese netizens , We classify the structural characteristics. Second, determining mutual impact of the inter-relations among all factors, drawing the final impact about all factors using the modified reachable matrix is used to get the inter-relationship between the factors. Then we divide hierarchy of all the factors and get interpretive structural model about factors on the structural characteristics in Chinese netizens. Third, we classify the factors and obtain the weight of each factor according to the modified Judgment matrix algorithm. The outcomes of the paper are significant for full utilization of Chinese Internet information resource and efficient implement of information policy.

articleTitle: Regional innovation network and enterprise innovation performance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper established a concept model of regional innovation network structure and enterprise innovation capabilities and performance. Hypotheses were tested based on the panel data of Guangdong Province. The interaction mechanism of regional innovation network and enterprise innovation performance was explored. The result showed that regional innovation network have a positive impact on enterprise innovation performance, the intermediary role of innovation capability was also examined.

articleTitle: Research on functional models for IP-based optical network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Wavelength-division multiplexing (WDM) is basically frequency division multiplexing in the optical frequency domain, where on a single optical fiber there are multiple communication channels at different wavelengths. In this paper, we first analyze the different IP/WDM networking functional models, then discuss the IP over switched WDM architecture. We present an analysis the potential benefits of MPLS networks. Currently, the optical network technology holds the key to the next-generation networks. In particular, wavelength-division-multiplexing (WDM) networks have emerged as a promising candidate for next-generation networks providing large available bandwidth. A WDM network consists of WDM switches connected by fiber optical links. In each link, multiple wavelengths are available.

articleTitle: Empirical research on internal control disclosure in China —based on management's standpoint
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The paper stands on companies' management, by constructing panel data model to analyse the factors to management's internal control disclosure, finds financial status is a significant impact on the behavior of management's disclosure; while the role of corporate governance is smaller than we expected although there was significant; time effect is particularly significant in the analysis, which provides empirical support for the effect of the policy of internal control disclosure issued by the state, which has certain reference.

articleTitle: Study on adaptive trends reactive power compensation control system based on DSP-PIC
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The paper studies the switching problem of reactive power compensation capacitor banks, and advances a designation scheme of trends reactive power compensation control system based on DSP-PIC which uses adaptive control technology, zero-voltage and zero-current switching control technology. The scheme can make the system always running in the optimal state.

articleTitle: Design of overload data acquisition system in parachute opening and landing process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper presents a portable and intelligent overload data acquisition system, which changes three directions of overload information into electrical signal by three micro-silicon accelerometers, during this process, digital potentiometer and MCU (MicroController Unit) are used to compensate temperature error and adjust the zero point of the output of accelerometers. Then instrumentation amplifier amplifies the analog signal in order to achieve the system requirements. In addition, A/D converter turns analog signal into digital signal. Finally, digital signal is sent to MCU for completing data acquisition. This system has simple structure, strong anti-interference ability and high measurement accuracy, therefore it has good prospects for the development.

articleTitle: Research on the impact factors of using mobile enterprise services in Hubei
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Mobile enterprise service develops quickly in recent years. This paper explored 25 main factors influencing acceptance of mobile enterprise service. Based on the valid data of questionnaires collected from the companies in Hubei, this study gives a list of influence factors using the logistic regression analysis. The result shows that the most three influential factors of the acceptance of mobile enterprise service are the purpose of enhancing the corporate image, the time of processing e-commerce and the purpose of reduce operating costs and etc. It can be concluded that those corporate with good development strategies and high degree of information are more likely to adopt mobile services.

articleTitle: Research on the mouse design of children
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The mouse has become a kind of children's products with high frequency. Badness operation posture will lead to children's health problem. There are some points often touch mouse in the operation, which include five finger belly, proximal interphalangeal joint, metacarpophalangeal joint, and three contacting points of palm. Appropriate design the location of these points on mouse shape will provide effective support and reduce the operation of the hand adjustment, meet the healthy requirements in operation.

articleTitle: Research method and framework for spatial organization in low-carbon region based on digital city technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In terms of methodology, technology and data demand, the study on spatial organization of functional network in low-carbon region (FNLCR) is identified by the spatialized and digitalized characteristics. Therefore, digital city technology (DCT) becomes important in the study of spatial organization of FNLCR. The research components and ideas are provided, and the research approach named digital low-carbon region (DLCR) with broad connections with DCT is proposed. An initiative framework of spatial organization of FNLCR is presented based on the platform of DCT, and it will help to establish a complete routine of digital low-carbon planning (DLCP) on regional scale.

articleTitle: Problems and solutions on overlay Dht testing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Nowadays, researchers try to verify their ideas through the real world wide Internet instead of simulate those in their own computer or labs. Recent research has shown that researcher can use overlay Distributed Hash Tables (DHTs) to run their applications, such as scalable, robust and efficient. Unfortunately, a would-be developer cannot easily deploy a DHT though many research prototype DHT implementations are available. Some worldwide platforms provide publicly accessible DHT service. Those kinds of platforms can issue at least put and get operations to any DHT node, which processes the operations on their behalf in contrast to the usual DHT model. Since just a few experts are up on those services, there are lots of problems puzzled new researchers. This paper introduces overlay DHT test-platform, points out the problems researchers would meet and figures out the solutions.

articleTitle: A new architecture of broadband network system suitable for asymmetric digital subscriber line application
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation on a new architecture of broadband network system which suitable for asymmetric digital subscriber line (ADSL) application. The main design skill is based on the cell-based digital IC design process, and is implemented in 0.18 μm 1P6M CMOS process. The main function of this chip is to build a bridge between Ethernet and ATM which is used to substitute for RISC processor, leading to enhance the broadband network switching ability and stability. Furthermore, the clock management system is adopted to manage the packages. By this technique, a small size and low cost chip will be obtained.

articleTitle: Empirical study on industrial structure and economic growth rate and benefit of Liaoning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The regional industrial structure is the combining mode that each industrial sector in the region relates to and depends on each other. The industrial structure of a region not only decides the relative status of a region in the interregional work division and trade relation, and the regional economic growth rate and benefit as well, but also restricts its capacity improving with economic growth to a large extent. This paper adopts the cluster analysis and deviation-share method to have empirical analysis to the influence of industrial structure level of Liaoning, composition of three industries and composition of manufacture industry on the economic growth rate and benefit of Liaoning, and puts forward the proposals for solving the problems existing in the industrial development.

articleTitle: Creating a Personal Knowledge Management system in a learning society
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Personal Knowledge Management (PKM) is conducive to the cultivation of a good habit of the knowledge collection, knowledge collation. It is used to help individuals and organizations to improve the performance and the competitiveness in the job. In this paper, on the basis of the discussion of the meaning of PKM, the developing background, the implementation process and the use of tools, the existing problems in the PKM, some countermeasures is put forwards which is including, to speed up the theory of PKM research and management tools for R&D, to develop good habits of PKM, to increase the popularity of PKM, and to be good at taking advantage of PKM system.

articleTitle: The Prospects of modern digital electronic media advertising
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper analyzes the application and role of digital electronic media in the mass advertising and explores the interaction, similarities and differences between digital electronic media and traditional media. The applications of the mobile TV advertising, Internet advertising, SMS advertising in real life are interpreted in detail. The development trends of digital electronic media are forecast. It is summarized that digital electronic media is the bond between advertising and audience.

articleTitle: The research of how e-business improves Hong Kong freight industry operations
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In recent years Hong Kong's logistics industry tends to slow down gradually although it still keeps the leader in freight industry comparing to its nearby cities. This research briefly reviews Hong Kong freight logistics industry; then it illustrates the function and working models of e-business in freight industry. By interviewing with professionals with in-depth interviews or seminar format, the research investigates how freight industry using e-business logistics to improve its operations generally in Hong Kong, the detailed suggestions are also discussed.

articleTitle: The teaching resources construction of the university physics---Demonstration of physical phenomena with the Java Applet
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper describes the development of the teaching resources construction of the university physics and proposed the ways to use the Java Applet to demonstrate physical phenomena. And through analysis of typical cases, we can learn the superiority of this method to construct the teaching resources of the university physics and improvement to the teaching of university physics.

articleTitle: Research on the construction of “resource-saving and environment-friendly society”
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: State Council approved the Changsha-Zhuzhou-Xiangtan Urban Agglomeration as a resource-saving and environment-friendly society comprehensive reform pilot area. This paper analysis the situation of the Changsha-Zhuzhou-Xiangtan Urban Agglomeration, and then give the solutions for the problems based on the objectives and requirements of the “resource-saving and environment-friendly society”. The paper gives some theoretical basis and practical reference for the construction in future.

articleTitle: Application study overview of magnetic suspension and magnetic suspension motor control technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Magnetic suspension and magnetic suspension motor control technology have developed with the development of magnetic suspension technology. In recent years, researches on magnetic suspension and magnetic suspension motor control technology are getting more and more active, and have made a lot of satisfactory achievement. This article systemically summarizes research achievement and current status all these years on magnetic suspension and magnetic suspension technology in motor control, at the same time put forward some questions that need further study and prospects to its future development.

articleTitle: Study on wireless intelligent surface acoustic wave CO gas sensor based on grid computing and Web service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Surface acoustic wave (SAW) gas sensors based on PANI (polyaniline) is studied experimentally and theoretically to overcome the Low sensitivity, high working temperature and high cost of the traditional CO gas sensors. The sensor networks system required that sensors have some function of Grid computing. In this paper, we discuss a model for interfacing sensors to grid computing and show how to use embedded Web service technology, ARM9 microprocessor, embedded Linux, embedded service toolkit SOAP implement intelligence and grid function of sensor. Fast response and recovery time with good repeatability were observed at room temperature.

articleTitle: E-Assessment in FLT settings: the past, issues and trends
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: computerized technology is increasingly becoming a powerful tool that has deeply influenced the development of educational testing. With aims to discuss the many benefits of electronic test in assessment practice, this paper is intended to give a brief review of what E-Assessment can offer for the measurement of people's skills, knowledge and competencies in terms of foreign language teaching and learning, with a particular focus on (1) test development, especially historical perspectives embodied in development of CALT; (2) some major concerns about the test development, test delivery and scoring system; (3) the challenge of computer testing systems in the future area of CALT.

articleTitle: The innovative ability upgrade of Shanghai medium and small-sized enterprises on the basis of independent innovation alliance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The medium and small-sized enterprises are the main body in independent innovations. The enthusiasm of medium and small-sized enterprises should be utilized. This paper puts forward three modes of independent innovation alliance: 1) Transverse innovation alliance mode; 2) Longitudinal innovation alliance mode; and 3) Dynamic network alliance mode. The author realizes that there is a large distance in the scientific and technological development between Shanghai and the developed countries and regions. There are problems in innovation concept, innovation participant and innovation mechanism, so the medium and small-sized enterprises in Shanghai can gain innovative ability in relevant technological and standardized independent innovations by independent innovation alliance and mutual assistance and gradually enter the stage of scale, accumulation, balanced and alliance development.

articleTitle: An improved access control model for digital products shopping System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The prevalence of the Internet has promoted the development of the electronic commerce. Digital products shopping system appeared in peoples' eyes. The security problems become very important. The core is how to guarantee the secure and flexible access of the digital products. As the most promising access control model, Usage control has been generally accepted. But the trust problem is the shortcoming of the model. In this paper, the usage control will be improved to apply in the digital products shopping system.

articleTitle: Research on evolution mechanism of enterprise IT outsourcing relationship
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: As competition intensifies, more and more enterprises outsource their IT. It is very important to enterprises that how to make IT outsourcing success. Outsourcing Relationship is one of the key issues of IT outsourcing. This paper firstly introduces the importance of IT outsourcing relationship; secondly, it analyses evolution dynamic of IT outsourcing relationship: external power including government, competitors, technology, suppliers and internal power including enterprise's management ability, top management and outsourcing project; thirdly, it analyses evolution path of IT outsourcing relationship: support, alignment, reliance and alliance; lastly, it forms evolution mechanism model to explain evolution mechanism of enterprise IT outsourcing relationship.

articleTitle: Research on service quality of campus vehicles based on SPSS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The quality of service is an important aspect of current social concern, and to meet the transport needs of teachers and students on campus is an important prerequisite for quality services. In the paper the evaluation index system of campus vehicle service quality was established based on AHP, and the Delphi method was used to determine the relative importance of individual index. The quality of campus vehicle service in Nanchang University was taken as an example, through multi-disciplinary and multi-level sampling survey of 120 people, 11 evaluation indexes were analyzed with SPSS statistical software. The analysis shows that the method proposed in the paper can accurately measure the current service quality of campus vehicles. The corresponding software and hardware improvement methods can be taken to improve the service quality for the emerging problems, which provides a fundamental guarantee for the scientific and standardized service management.

articleTitle: Algorithms and algorithm analysis of logical difference operation of variable precision upper approximation operator and grade lower approximation operator
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The aim of this contribution is to construct new operation of approximation operators, and explore its calculation. It proposes logical difference operation of variable precision upper approximation operator and grade lower approximation operator. Then regular algorithm and structural algorithm are proposed and analyzed, and furthermore it obtains an important conclusion that structural algorithm has advantages in space complexity. Finally the new operation and its algorithms are illustrated by a medical example.

articleTitle: New development trend of college English interpretation teaching in the E-learning environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: English interpretation course is a training course of skills and techniques based on the grasp of the basic English competence. The subject of interpretation training is students, so it is very essential to provide students with an authentic English environment. Traditional college English interpretation class can hardly offer authentic interpretation situations, thus some problems have occurred, which have greatly influenced the qualities of interpretation training. Compared with the traditional mode of college English interpretation teaching, E-learning, as a method of foreign language teaching aids, plays an important role in creating the interpreting environment, increasing the opportunities of students' use of foreign language and practice of interpretation in the authentic situations. It also can activate the enthusiasm of students' learning. In the E-learning environment, English interpretation teaching has shown new development trend, which is helpful to the improvement of the quality of college English interpretation teaching.

articleTitle: A improved video watermarking scheme based on spread-spectrum technique
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper presents a improved video watermarking technology based on the MPEG-4 standard and the spread-spectrum technique. The watermarks are embedded in the luminance's DCT direct current coefficient of the video's ‘I’ frames. It need not to decode fully when the watermarking is embedded and extracted. As a result, the complication of operation is predigested and the capability of real time is improved. Furthermore, experimental results show that because the watermark is embedded in the luminance's DCT direct current coefficient rather than in the chroma's DCT direct current coefficient, the video effect is distorted less, and the watermark is still steady.

articleTitle: What affect the acceptance of mobile marketing?
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Mobile marketing is said accurate and can be executed anywhere and anytime. It could provide accurate and useful information to consumer. But consumers did not show enough enthusiasm in reality. What blocks the acceptance of mobile marketing? The authors develop a framework that links user innovativeness character and service provider brand with the acceptance of mobile marketing. The present structural equation model encompasses these relationships on the basis of a survey of 226 mobile consumers. Empirical analysis shows that consumer innovativeness characters will affect their knowledge about mobile marketing, thus, increase the acceptance of mobile marketing. While the brand of service provider can help decrease perceived uncertainty. These findings imply that service provider should aim innovative consumers and use brand to provide enough guarantee.

articleTitle: The analysis of wireless resource configuration under extreme traffic impact
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Under the extreme traffic impact the whole wireless access network exposes certain problems. In this paper, through the analysis of the wireless access network performance under the extreme situation, identify the wireless network bottlenecks and improve the wireless resources configuration flexibility to resist the extreme traffic impact. Compare and analyze the resource distribution and the traffic distribution under the normal and the abnormal wireless resource utilization rate. Based on the analysis of normal situation, reasonable suggestions about the resource configuration under the abnormal situation are proposed, in order to improve the anti-impact capacity in emergency.

articleTitle: The exploration of large-scale seamless image database
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: With the rapid development of technology of aviation, aerospace, sensor and computer, the improvement of commercialization level and application popularization of the software of digital photogrammetry and remote sensing image processing, has opened a broad prospect for image data acquisition, process and application. Image data as a main carrier of spatial data is playing an increasingly important role in the field of geographic information. Vector data is mainly used in current GIS software. The establishment of vector database is the basic function of many GIS software such as GEOSTAR, MAPGIS etc. However the technology for establishment for establishment of mass image database and management is not mature, which has strictly restricted the management, distribution, sharing and application of image data. At present, the construction of National Spatial Data Infrastructure (NSDI)and Digital Earth imminently need efficient management of multi-scale and multi-resource mass image data. The data seamless organization, seamless display and roaming algorithms for image database in province level with multiple resolutions and projection zones in geometry and level spaces are put forward.

articleTitle: Application and analysis of IEEE 802.14.5 security services
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: With the application of wireless sensor networks, many applications not only have ease of installation, reliable data transfer, short-range operation, and extremely low cost and reasonable battery life, whilst maintaining a simple and flexible protocol, but also should have high confidentiality. So the research of the security of the IEEE 802.15.4 is becoming very important. The IEEE 802.15.4 specification describes wireless and media access protocols for personal area networking devices. In this paper, we mainly discuss IEEE 802.14.5 data transmission security services, the encryption techniques, security key, secured Frames Format. At last we introduce the security application based on IEEE 802.15.4.

articleTitle: Research on e-commerce mode of food enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Food enterprises integrate supply chain management and e-commerce, in order to form complete e-supply chain. It is a better mode of promoting food businesses to develop rapidly. Food enterprises are rather unfamiliar with the use of e-commerce in China. The article points out the necessity of integrating e-commerce for food enterprises, starting with the analysis of four stages of developing e-commerce. With the analysis of advantages and deficiencies of food enterprises developing e-commerce, the article discusses objective requirement for food enterprises and proposes the countermeasures based on the present situation of food industry.

articleTitle: Research on current mobile e-commerce development of China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The current mobile e-commerce has developed rapidly in China, but it also faces many problems to be solved. This paper describes the latest development situation of the domestic mobile e-commerce, explores the mobile e-commerce problems and relevant solutions proposed, and does some simple guess about the future development of mobile e-commerce with a view to provide reference to the future the development of mobile e-commerce.

articleTitle: LBA: Location and Bandwidth Awareness overlay for P2P live video streaming
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Peer-to-peer streaming technology using mesh-based overlay has emerged as a promising scalable solution for live video streaming. However, the mechanism of nodes randomly selecting neighbors without considering peer location and bandwidth can cause a serious video diffusion delay which is undesirable. In this paper, we propose a Location and Bandwidth Awareness (LBA) overlay scheme aiming to achieve low delay. We make use of the concept of Location and Bandwidth (LB) balance which regulates the ratio of nearby neighbors and high bandwidth neighbors and give LB balance model. Each peer must obey LB balance so that the peers are organized into a hierarchy. In order to construct LBA overlay, we present a centralized algorithm which peers select their proper neighbors based on the LB balance. Simulation shows that our LBA overlay can achieve desirable performance, and substantially outperforms traditional and state-of-the-art approaches.

articleTitle: High-speed coupling of library automation application system and one card solution system of campus
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper first systematically introduces the coupling extent of the one card solution system platform and the building goal of the one card solution system of campus as well as the application subsystem, then elaborates the high-speed coupling method of library automation application system and the one card solution system of campus, which not only achieves the management goal of the one card solution system of campus, but also protects the initial investment of the library, thus ensures the normal and stable operation of library automation application subsystem.

articleTitle: Apply the formative assessment and fuzzy mathematics into college English online learning evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: College English Curriculum Requirements demands that we should apply the formative assessment into students' learning evaluation. This paper illustrates that the formative assessment theory and practice, then points out that the formative assessment is a much better assessment in language learning, and it can promote students' language ability mostly, even students' all round-development. Finally, this paper establishes an effective formative assessment index system of college English online learning and examines it with the fuzzy mathematics.

articleTitle: The inverse generalized eigenvalue problem for generalized jacobi matrices
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper presents the following inverse eigenvalue problem for generalized Jacobi matrices: Give two characteristic pairs and a matrix, get a generalized Jacobi matrix (That is the product of secondary diagonal elements of the Jacobi matrix is positive). Let the two characteristic pairs are the characteristic pairs of the inverse generalized eigenvalue problem. The paper discussed the existence and uniqueness of the question's solution. And the expression of the solution of the problem is given, and some numerical example is provided.

articleTitle: Dynamic data broadcasting dispatching technology based on hyper graph in unsymmetrical network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Data broadcasting is an important technology to improve the retractility of mobile computation system in unsymmetrical network. In the paper, a kind of multi-disk broadcasting dispatching technology is presented based on hyper graph, which can determine the amount of disks, the contribution of data items to each disks and their relative frequency by computer. The theoretical analysis and experiment results indicate that the method can greatly improve the average visiting time of data item .

articleTitle: Research of digital resources integration of university library under network environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: With the arrival of the network and digital age, the library's holdings of resources has undergone a drastic change in which the proportion of digital resources occupy an instantly increase. The digital resources are easy to share and retrieve. This article discusses the need for integration of university library's digital resources, the principles and contents of integration. several integrated model of digital resources which are suitable for university libraries are proposed. Utilization of resource will be improved significantly by the one-stop inquiries of digital resources which is achieved by integration of resources.

articleTitle: The application of Digital Interactive Storytelling in Serious Games
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper analyses the similarities between the Digital Interactive Storytelling(DIS) and Serious Games, which are both benefit for Technology-Enhanced Learning(TEL). It constructs the process of how to applicate the DIS into Serious Games and demonstrates some new technologies should be used to support the integration of DIS and Serious Games.

articleTitle: Two Rounds Game CSMA algorithm of WSNs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Based on game theory, a general mathematical model, named by TRG/CSMA (Two Rounds Game CSMA), is proposed. TRG/CSMA select τ (the sending data packet probability) as optimization variable, and build a model named by n-persons non-cooperative game with mixed strategy. In this article, as special example, the throughput and delay is selected as optimization object, plays a game among n nodes respectively, and arrives at the Nash equilibrium point respectively. Further, it comes into being a compromise τ* between the throughput and the delay in the second round game. At last, we adjust the minimum contention window CWmin on basis of τ*. The simulation experiment indicates that TRG/CSMA improves the transmission efficiency of MAC protocol greatly. Further TRG/CSMA might select more networks performance as optimization object (packet loss, power exhaust, fairness) and play game, the final Nash equilibrium can be used to compromise contradictions of various network performance.

articleTitle: Research on the evaluation of customer satisfaction under B2C e-commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In the context of an e-commerce thriving on the rapid development of network economy, it is of great significance in both theory and practice to explore the customer satisfaction under B2C e-commerce. In this paper, an evaluation index system of customer satisfaction is established from four dimensions, such as convenience of transaction, security of transaction, value of commodity and service quality. An evaluation model is also constructed based on Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (FAHP). Empirical analysis shows that the evaluation system of customer satisfaction has strong operationality and application value.

articleTitle: Analysis of the interaction between digital art and traditional art
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The great art form is accomplished from constant accumulations in life, it needs generalization and refining rather than pure imagination. We only have to absorb and integrate the advantages of various art forms in order to create more outstanding works of art that facilitate the audience to accept and recognize. Therefore, digital art and traditional art will obtain better development if they integrate and learn from each other. Especially as the form of new digital art, it should be open-minded to the traditional art of learning, so as to continuously strengthening their creative energy.

articleTitle: An HMM segmentation method based statistical layered model for an image of vehicle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: An HMM segmentation method based statistical layered model for an image including interest vehicle is brought forward. In statistical layered model, the interest vehicle is called foreground layer and other moving object is called background layer and shadow of moving objects is called shadow layer and is expressed by the statistical model respectively. The model parameters are estimated by the HMM-based method of video sequences. HMM- based method makes use of the spatial relativity and time relativity of video sequences to accomplish recognition of model. The experimental results show that this method can succeed segmenting the moving vehicle.

articleTitle: A hierarchical scheduling scheme for wireless sensor surveillance network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Obtaining long system lifetime as well as maintaining sufficient surveillance to targets is one of the most important challenges in the design of wireless sensor surveillance network. The effective lifetime of system is defined and then a hierarchical scheduling scheme is presented, in order to reduce the communication overhead and prolong the effective lifetime of system in differentiated surveillance. Simulations show that better performance in effective lifetime and fault-tolerance can be achieved with the scheme than most other schemes.

articleTitle: On the edge-balance index sets of Cn × P2
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In this paper, the edge-friendly and the edges-balance index set are defined, the edges-balance index set of C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub> × P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> (n ≡ 0,1(mod 4))and a structural method of graphs are researched.

articleTitle: Analysis and design of personalized recommendation system for university physical education
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: How to provide students with personalized physical education (P.E) course has become particularly urgent with the development of information technology in teaching of P.E and the increasing personalized demands of contemporary college students. This paper starts with the analysis of college students' demands for P.E classes, introducing ideas and technology about personalized recommendation, analyzes the functions and processes of the personalized recommendation system for P.E course at universities. Then, this paper designs the system application architecture.

Author Keywords: informatization of the college physical education

articleTitle: The research on microblogging application at the Web-based Education
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Microblogging is one of the latest Web 2.0 technologies with the most important impact in the recent months, with applications in many domains, including education. This paper describes the microblogging and its service platform. Then based on analyzing characteristics of microblogging, this paper discusses microblogging application of interactive teaching and collaborative learning for the purpose of propelling vigorous development of Web-based Education.

articleTitle: Teaching interactively with interactive whiteboard: ----Teachers are the key
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The new interactive technology of interactive whiteboard into the classroom, bring a lot of opportunities for teaching. Compared with other information technology tools, the uniqueness and the ‘boon’ of IWB technology lies in the possibility for an intersection between technical and pedagogic interactivity; in other words, in the opportunities this technology holds for collective meaning making through both dialogic interaction with one another, and physical interaction with the board. So, what the intersection between technical and pedagogic interactivity looks like in classroom? We believe that teachers are the key to achieve teach interactively with interactive whiteboard. Because they must understand the nature of interactive teaching; and decide which kind of pedagogical strategies and teaching methods and design teaching activities.

articleTitle: A new conceptional model for merger waves: Industry competition diffusion based on complex networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The existing two main ways to interpret the formation of merge waves are neo-classical approach and behavior finance approach. Both of these two methods focus on exogenous variables influence, such as the industry shock, shakeout, stock price fluctuation, manager's behaviors and so forth, while they neglect effects of endogenous variables, such as the interactive competition among enterprises and market structure. In this study, the avalanche effect theory of complex network, industry competitive pressure theory and Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) theory are skillfully combined. It puts forward new ideas that competitive pressures diffusion leads to merger waves. The ideas and theoretical framework is expected to explain the formation process of merger waves from the perspective of industry competition structure. Meanwhile, this method will transfer the research object from individual enterprise to the relationship among enterprises, and find a comprehensive and integrated research framework for the analysis between enterprise-level competitive behavior of individual micro-analysis and industry-level statistical behavior of macro-analysis.

articleTitle: Electronic seal system based on RSA algorithm and public-key infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: With the development of the internet, many important documents can be exchanged online. It is vital to protect the safety and genuineness of the seals in the published documents. In this paper, a new electronic seal system based on the RSA digital signature algorithm and public-key infrastructure is presented. The RSA digital signature algorithm and its mathematic foundation are discussed in detail and the feasibility of the electronic seal scheme implementation based on public-key infrastructure is given. The scheme combines one-way hash function and digital watermarking, implements the tamper-proofing of electronic documents, anti-copy of electronic seal and secure access control function, can effectively to meet the basic needs of electronic document and security requirements.

articleTitle: Channel estimation technology based on windowing in OFDM system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: A kind of channel estimation algorithm was proposed that based on orthogonal frequency division multiplexing system according to the current lack of channel estimation methods. This algorithm adding windowing techniques on the channel frequency response, that makes power spectral density outside the bandwidth declines rapidly, and then, through a low-pass filter to filter out of band noise, which reduces the estimation error response. The improved algorithm has the characteristics of a small calculate and a simple structure and so on. By using Matlab tool, simulation results indicate that the improved algorithm has a lower bit error rate compared to the original channel estimation algorithm, especially in high SNR cases.

articleTitle: Agricultural robot path tracking based on predictable path
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In order to realize the path tracking of agricultural robot in complex farmland environment and improve its speed and accuracy, a kind of agricultural robot path tracking method based predictable path was put forward in this paper. The definition of predictable path and fitting were presented, the positioning principles and methods were described in detail. The implementation method of path tracking and fitting was elaborated. The experimental results showed that the path-tracking method was of high accuracy, small absolute error and so on.

articleTitle: Using JiTT to design: How blending learning is to be improved by mobile learning?
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This thesis has created a new Instructional Design combined with mobile learning and blending learning based on the instructional mode of JiTT, after our research on a software SuperMemo, new application can be used in network teaching which has been discovered, it is not only a software used to remember words, but also learning other knowledge by segements of a subject in the form of question-answer.

articleTitle: Encapsulating Matlab linear regression function as web service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: for implementing the online linear regression for the chemical product development process, based on web service technology, a linear regression service is proposed by encapsulating the linear regression function in Matlab. The service can get real-time data from winCC control platform and execute linear regression to get a regression function, and the GAMS will use the regression function to create online optimization model. The practicability and validity of the linear regression service is verified through the application in the product development process on Micro-Plant.

articleTitle: A roust algorithm of constructing panorama
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: A robust stitching algorithm of panorama is proposed to improve the efficiency and accuracy of constructing panorama. Firstly, pyramid based image is formed according to the input images, and then use the least local entropy and Sequential Similarity Detection Algorithm with adaptive threshold to complete the stitching of the panoramic images . The experiments show that the method has the properties of anti-noise and anti-geometrical deformation. It indicates a high robustness to images taken by camera in common condition.

articleTitle: The optimization of the P2P network based on topology within MAN
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: To utilize P2P as the carrying technology for HD-VOD within MAN, the traffic distribution on every hierarchical links is analyzed, which shows the most traffic would pass through the core switch and induces the jam in the backbone. The optimizing method is proposed to eliminate the jam by selecting the nearest source node as the preferred. The analysis proves that the traffic through the core switch decreases greatly by regulating the traffic from the backbone to the edge of MAN. Then the P2P system is designed for HD-VOD in MAN with a topology server to control the P2P traffic distribution in the optimization mode, and the algorithm for the nearest source node is put forward.

articleTitle: The design of Home Gateway which used in FTTH
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The paper proposes the design of Home Gateway used in FTTH. On the customer's side, the Home Gateway finishes the optical signal receiving, provides three kinds of interfaces for the high-definition video, voice, data, and attains the integration of the three services. Especially on the aspect of the video services, the HG system combines the advantages of IPTV and the DVB to offer a platform for receiving two kind of signals.

articleTitle: The research on the enterprise value-oriented financial analysis system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The enterprises' financial analysis has an impact on the interests of all stakeholders, and the enterprise value is the focus of the financial analysis. In the paper, the author assessed the enterprises' real value and then built the financial analysis framework based on the enterprise value from the two aspects: profitability and the level of risk.

articleTitle: A new generic generating algorithm for rank n integer DCT transform radix
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In this paper, a new generic generating algorithm for rank n integer DCT transform radix is proposed. The relation of amounts of coefficients in radix and rank of matrix and an generic generating algorithm for rank n (n=2 <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sup> ,k>0) integer DCT transform radix are found and proved in this paper based on theory of integer DCT and characteristic of cosine function. Through reordering variations of coefficient, the mid-polynomials have strong laws. The group of polynomials in N variable is resolved by design a N-digits with M as radix implementing N-loops. The experimental result show that the algorithm can find all valid radix for n×n (n=2 <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sup> ,k>0) integer DCT if computers power enough.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of safety measurement to bus insulation resistance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In this paper, it has been deeply analyzed and studied the safety measurement to bus insulation resistance in the production of smelting for long-term. According to the specific system characteristics, it has brought forward the test method of introducing filter module and the equivalent resistance while program-controlled amplifiers and high-precision A/D have been combined use. It made the measurement system with self-adaptive characteristics of measuring range to improve measurement accuracy. So it completely abandons the insecurity factor caused by the traditional single-use meter measurement. By several experimental measurements, it shows that the production methods used in this paper are feasible and safe. It can effectively overcome the impact of the magnetic field in the bus system, distributed capacitance, the stress field to measurement. It has great significance and broad application prospects to make system running smoothly, maintain balanced stable production, make a good bus system in a controlled state and ensure the entire production system safe running.

articleTitle: Efficiency evaluation of listed companies with “internet of things” and “3G” concepts in the electronic information industry based on AHP-DEA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In recent years, electronic information industry has been developed rapidly. Many companies in the industry have been listed on the security market in China. They are very popular in the stock market and have achieved excellent performance, as well as value returns to the shareholders. Some of them have “internet of things” concept, and some of them have “3G” concept. Even four of them occupy both of the two concepts. Under current circumstance in China's knowledge economy, structure of economy is necessary to transform, so there are many opportunities for the information industry, especially for the companies with the above two concepts. Thus, the efficiency evaluation on the performance of such companies is very important. This paper utilizes AHP (Analytical Hierarchy Process) and DEA (Data Envelopment Analysis) model to evaluate the four listed companies by selecting some financial indicators of them.

articleTitle: Analysis of relative structure on main influence factors of Supplier Involvement in New Product Development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: All domestic and foreign literatures on the influence factors of Supplier Involvement in New Product Development (SINPD) are statistically analyzed by using Meta-analysis method in this paper, and 14 main influence factors of SINPD are identified and extracted from previous research results. After that, the paper analyzes the relative structure among the 14 main influence factors by using interpretive structural model. The results show that supplier dependence, product complexity, development risk, technology uncertainty, supplier's technology capability and technology novelty are superficial and direct influence factors; expectation of obtaining long-term performance, expectation of obtaining short-term performance and R&D dependence are intermediate and indirect influence factors; ability of organization and management, human resource quality, cooperation relationship, attraction between supplier and manufacturer, and manufacturers' competition environment are essential and basic influence factors. This analysis could provide a meaningful analytical base to effectively actualize SINPD.

Author Keywords: supplier involvement in new product development

articleTitle: Application of Power Testing Based on Infrared Wireless Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The paper has made use of infrared imaging and wireless communications technique, temperature image long-distance collection, mobile image capture, lossless compression and wireless communications technology. It can inspect, analyze and predict the device with keep clear of running equipment, no power cut and no stop machine. The electrical equipment has been settled on the puzzle with safety inspection and management. It has provided a solid foundation for the corporation to achieve stably power supply. It has come true truly implement unmanned on duty with automatic, omni-direction and intelligence. It can be provided with a good promotional application value

articleTitle: Steady academic model of complicated market system based on customer satisfaction index
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Market system is a complicated system which is consisted of economic running quality, Supply-demand price elasticity, market delicacy and national macro-economy policy. Customer satisfaction index has been an important general index to evaluate economic condition. The paper structures system model of second-order complicated market based on customer satisfaction index, market tardiness (reciprocal of market delicacy), supply-demand price elasticity and market fluctuation. The paper introduces parameter—market tardiness-ratio ξ to analysis and study complicated market academic model in qualitative. It concludes that customer satisfaction index is the weatherglass of marketing quality.

articleTitle: Grating-Ruler signal based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: As a high precision measurement displacement sensor, Grating-Ruler has been used widely. In this paper, we present a method which combines FPGA (XC3S100E) device, hardware description language (Verilog) and EDA software (XILINX ISE) to deal with the output signal from Grating-Ruler. The whole processing is made of three parts: signal preprocessing module, subdivided and direction-judgement module, reversible counter module. Our analysis and simulation results show that this method is more reliable and has shorter development cycle than traditional methods. Moreover, we can modify the system's functions easily according to the specific characteristics of FPGA.

articleTitle: E-commerce website assessment based on rough set theroy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In order to avoid the evaluation process using only a subjective or objective weight caused by one-sidedness of the evaluation, a method of determining subjective weight based on the rough set theory is presented in this paper. Determining subjective weight is translated into estimating significance of attributes among rough sets, and build a combination weight. Finally, an example shows that this method is effective for the evaluation of e-commerce websites providing a new analysis methods and research ideas.

articleTitle: Application of CMAC-based algorithm of critics & strategists on robot tracking control
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The CMAC-based algorithm of critics & strategists is proposed in this article for application on robot tracking control. This tracking controller comprises position tracking controller and angle tracking controller, whose outputs are line rotation speed control value and angle control value respectively. Both of them include in two CMAC controllers dealing with online weight value adjustment through the δ learning rule. The strategy CMAC is used to generate control quantity, while the evaluation CMAC is used to perform online adjustment for the strategy CMAS on the basis of controlled errors. Taking double-wheel driven autonomous mobile robot as an example, comparing with the fixed learning rate CMAC, the simulation data indicates that the tracking controller based on CMAC reinforcement learning algorithm features high tracking speed, strong self-adapting ability, wide range of configuration parameters, and independence of mathematical model etc.

articleTitle: The analysis of IQ influencing factors in the environment of S&T information-sharing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Information quality (IQ) is a prerequisite for the development of S&T information-sharing. However, in the current situation, IQ issue becomes a sticking-out obstacle that seriously hinder S&T information-sharing implementation, Due to the special characteristics of IQ in the practice of S&T information-sharing in China, the existing IQ research literatures can seldom guide IQ management work effectively in this field. Therefore, it is difficult to find key factors which influence IQ, and select the appropriate quality control measures and methods. Toward the goal of IQ improvement, this paper analyzes key IQ influencing factors from two-levels: macro IQ influence factors and micro IQ influence factors. And then put forwards view points about how to select and determine IQ influence factors which really affecting the quality of S&T information-sharing.

articleTitle: On super 3-restricted edge connectivity of regular strong product graphs with girth at least four
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: It is known that communication networks with topologies being super 3-restricted edge connected graphs are more reliable under some reasonable conditions. Let G<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> be maximally edge connected k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> - regular graphs with k <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub>≥ 3, i = 1,2 . It is proved in this work that if g(G<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub>) ≥ 4 , then the strong product G<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>⊗G<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> of graphs G<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> and G<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> is super 3 -restricted edge connected.

articleTitle: Investigation of GPS-based embedded guiding system for scenic spots
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In the case of self-help tourism, the tourist may get lost or miss some scenic spots. To solve these problems, this paper systematically studies the design of a self-guided tour of scenic spots system based on FS2410, describes the principles and functional modules of the system, and studies in depth how to display GPS positioning dynamically by using Qt/Embedded. The system implements map showing, GPS tracking, and video of attractions automatically playing, scenic spots enquiries and so on. Finally, Drum Mountain Scenic Area in Fuzhou is taken for example to testify the feasibility of the embedded guiding system. The example shows that the system has friendly interface, simplified operation and rich information, which will bring great convenience for self-helped tourists.

articleTitle: Resolution to ERP system model of coalmine enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: It defines that ERP is a tool for coalmine enterprise to realize its development strategy objectives and strengthen its core competitiveness on the basis of analysis of coal enterprise information construction and management. Then it sets up coal mining ERP model oriented to coalmine enterprise resources integration and management optimization, including coal mining ERP management model and management technique according to supply chain theory. Accordingly it puts forward module composition of coalmine ERP and points out that core module of coalmine ERP is raw coal production plan, coal cutting operation plan and headwork operation plan included, whose MRP decided by its operation work respectively. Therefore coalmine enterprise ERP model built and its master production schedule decided solve a critical problem for the ERP applications in the coal industry without master production scheduling all along.

articleTitle: Fast gossip-based overlay construction by adaptive membership exchange
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Traditional gossip communications does not consider the difference between nodes in the overlay, and fix the number of node descriptors exchanged during an interaction. It severely reduces the effectiveness of the overlay construction. It takes nodes more time to reach stable state, and when a node achieves stable state, useless node descriptors exchanging incurs extra network bandwidth wasting. This paper proposes a novel adaptive method for membership information exchanging, which promotes the convergence speed of the overlay obviously and decreases extra bandwidth cost during maintaining neighbor views period.

articleTitle: Data services model for process operation system platform development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: chemical product development and manufacture process fill with complicated technical problems. In order to find a solution for process operation system information development, a data integration model is proposed based on STEP and XML technologies. The theory and methodology of information integration of process industry are discussed. A chemical experimental platform is introduced, which is developed in kilogram-scale, and especially for fine and specialties chemicals in batches. To realize the optimization and control of the experimental platform, data services are presented based on STEP/XML data integration model. Finally, in order to verify the function of proposed model and the performance of the platform, a case study on nipagin ethyl ester process is carried out.

articleTitle: The effect analysis of Postscript file content recovery in Windows
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: To study the content of a document has been printed in a computer is a branch of Computer Forensics. In this paper, through studying the Postscript format of the printed documents in the Windows operating system, analyze the methods about recovery content of the printed document, and then has an effect analysis of the Postscript content recovery.

articleTitle: Research on wavelength-selective routing optical network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In this article, an efficient heuristic approach for routing and wavelength-selective(RWS) in wavelength-division multiplexing (WDM) optical networks is proposed. The high bandwidth of fiber-optic links is utilized through the WDM technology which supports the propagation of multiple laser beams through a single fiber-optic link provided that each laser beam uses a distinct optical wavelength. Thus, optical communication introduces a new routing environment with new characteristics different from traditional one. Wavelength converters are used to effectively alleviate the blocking probability and help to resolve contention at the output port of switches by shifting one incoming wavelength to another outgoing wavelength at an OXC node. With the help of wavelength converters, the WDM optical network will utilize the wavelength resources efficiently.

articleTitle: Optimal digital control based on DSP controller
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper describes the features of the Texas Instruments TMS320C24x digital signal processor (DSP), a low cost, single chip solution for optimal digital control system applications. This solution is a tribute to the integration of not only a powerful DSP core, but also to its specialized digital control circuit (known as the event manager) and a comprehensive set of desired peripherals.

articleTitle: The study on risk factors associated with information system project performance from knowledge resources view
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Improving our understanding of how various factors influence project performance is therefore an important research objective. This study proposes and tests a model of information system project performance from knowledge management perspective. The results confirm the importance of knowledge resources, project management practices to project performance.

articleTitle: The analysis and design of two-dimensional nearly-orthogonal symmetric wavelet filter
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The analysis and design of two-dimensional nearly-orthogonal symmetric wavelet filter has been studied. Methods for analyzing the correlation of the nearly-orthogonal filter banks are proposed. The basic idea is to impose multiple zeros at the aliasing frequency to a symmetric filter, minimize the deviation of the filter satisfying the orthogonal condition, then a nearly orthogonal filter bank can be obtained. The way in this paper is to find a FIR complementary filter of the minimized filter and thus construct a perfect reconstructed biorthogonal filter bank. Then a corresponding wavelet filter bank can be generated and correlation analysis can also be conducted.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of enterprise CRM system based on grey-fuzzy theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: It is of great theoretical and practical significance to evaluate the performance of enterprise CRM system. This paper establishes a performance evaluation index system for enterprise CRM system from the perspective of main subject of performance evaluation. Based on the grey-fuzzy theory, it also constructs a grey-fuzzy comprehensive performance evaluation model for the CRM system, and verifies the model's scientificalness and feasibility through empirical study.

articleTitle: Supporting flexible queries for autonomous E-Commerce Web databases
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The rapid expansion of the World Wide Web has made a large number of E-Commerce Web databases like used cars, houses databases etc. to become accessible to lay users. These users often have vague or imprecise query intentions when searching the E-Commerce Web databases and may not know how to precisely formulate queries that lead to satisfactory answers. This paper proposes a novel approach of the flexible query and results ranking by using query relaxation mechanism in order to present ranked relevant answers to the users. Based on the user original query, we speculate how much the user cares about each attribute and assign a corresponding weight to it. Then, each tuple in the initial query results is relaxed according to the attribute weight and is acted as a relaxed query to obtain the similar tuples from the database. The relaxation order of all attributes and the relaxed degree on each attribute are varied with the attribute weights. For the relevant answers, they are finally ranked according to their similarity to the initial query. The efficiency of our approach is also demonstrated by experimental result.

articleTitle: Breaking a proxy ring signature with revocable anonymity in MINE2009
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Proxy signature is an important delegation technique. Since it was introduced in 1996, many variants of proxy signature schemes have been proposed. Among of them, the requirement of proxy signer's privacy protection and the revocation of proxy signer's anonymous identity are needful in some practical applications.
