Recently, Wang et.al gave a new signature type: proxy ring signature with revocable anonymity. It allows that proxy signer anonymously produces a proxy signature. However, it is anonymous for the others except that the original signer can know exactly who is the actual proxy signer. Unfortunately, in this paper, by analyzing the scheme, we show that the scheme does not satisfy anonymity, that is to say, given an anonymous proxy signature, the others also can know the actual identity of proxy signer beside original signer. At the same time, it cannot also revoke anonymity of proxy signer's identity. Finally, we give the corresponding attacks on the scheme and the reasons to produce suck attacks.

articleTitle: The exploration on Double-subject Interaction, Project-based Hybrid learning mode based on network environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: How to use the Computer Multimedia, full use of Network Resources to achieve Individualized Teaching and Learning, which is a hot issue. Based upon a survey pertaining to the current situation of electives in Universities, pointing out a deviation between the Training Objective and the Modern Teaching Mode, we constructed a teaching model named Double-subject Interaction, Project-based Hybrid learning(DPHL), and demonstrated the implementation modalities of the model in more detail, with an expectation to be beneficial to Higher Education Reform.

articleTitle: Multiparty quantum determined key distribution protocol using GHZ states
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: A multiparty quantum determined key distribution protocol using GHZ(Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger) states is presented in this paper. Three parties can build a key with the help of GHZ states. The key can be a determined string in our protocol while the key is a random string built in the process of key distribution in previous protocols. We prove that our protocol is guaranteed to be unconditionally secure by the laws of quantum mechanics.

Author Keywords: multiparty quantum determined key distribution protocol

articleTitle: Research about component library management based on decision tree
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: To retrieve and extract the most satisfying among the library of components is important in component library management system. The general component retrieval system seldom provides information about respect of reused actually. Data mining technology provides a feasible approach to above problem. In the paper, how to use the application of classification method decision-tree-based to the component reuse was discussed. In accordance with the limitation of research on traditional software component library management, we proposed the idea to apply data mining technology to the management of software component, provided auxiliary decision support to the relevant personnel of the component library. Secondly, in accordance with actual application, built an applied model of software component retrieval management by data mining technology, and analyzed the execution step of the applied model. Lastly, the model had been verified through experiment, thus the feasibility and validity of this strategy had been verified.

articleTitle: Research on the motion estimation algorithm in AVS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Motion estimation is the process of selecting an offset to a suitable reference area in a previously coded frame. In this paper, the Predictive Motion Vector Field Adaptive Search Technique (PMVFAST) and Enhanced-PMVFAST (EPMVFAST) algorithm was reviewed, and we studied in detail the motion estimation technology in AVS in two parts: soft and hard decision process in motion estimation, soft-decision based local search pattern.

articleTitle: Based on the WebGIS's forest resource monitoring and management platform research
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: To establish a perfect forest dynamic monitoring system, to strengthen and enhance the monitoring capacity completely, and speed up the pace of modern forestry construction. This paper is based on B / S model of multi-layer network of forest information management systems, and based on the J2EE and ArcGIS Server technology, combining GIS theory and WebGIS's crux technology to design a forest resource management information system which is based on a network user operating interactively online, and simultaneously with the spatial information query and analyzing functions. Utilizing the information network system, and achieving the sub-level management information monitoring and sharing.

articleTitle: The service innovation study of the e-business enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The e-business has played more and more important role in our social and economic activities, but the existing documents about the e-business have the tendency which emphasizes the technique and neglects the business theory. So the development of the e-business enterprise lacks the necessary guidance coming from the management theory. The service innovation is a kind of essential impetuses during the development of the e-business enterprise. The research about the nature of the e-business enterprise's service innovation has more profound meaning for China which has great population and economy scale. Therefore, this paper mainly studies the e-business enterprise's service innovation based on the four dimensions model of the service innovation, and provides theoretical instructions for the development of the e-business enterprise in China.

articleTitle: Temporal data collection for distributed simulation based on web services
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: On basis of HLA distributed simulation extension with web services and data collection objective analysis, a method of distributed simulation temporal data collection based on web services is proposed and corresponding architecture is designed. In combination with simulation temporal database model of single attribute, rapid collecting and real-time query of HLA distributed simulation temporal data is realized under service oriented architecture. The prototype and corresponding tests indicate that application of simulation temporal database model of single attribute can take high efficiency of collection and query; the key factors which affect overall performance of data collection are network transmission delay of bottom runtime infrastructure and parsing efficiency of SOAP engine.

articleTitle: The study on management and service of digital archives in Web 2.0
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In the perspective of web 2.0's technical concept, characteristics and architecture, this paper discusses the feasibility, necessity and roles of web 2.0 technology in digital archives service and management system, and analyzes the architecture of Web 2.0 applications in the system.

articleTitle: The comprehensive evaluation model of Chang-Zhu-Tan Urban Agglomeration “two-oriented society”
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: With the fifth plenary session of the sixteenth CPC central committee was first proposed to establish “two-oriented society”, then, the concept also went into the visual field of scholars. Domestic scholars carried out extensive studies on the evaluation model and method of the “two-oriented society”. Foreign scholars had done a lot of research mainly from the level of sustainable development and related models. However, they are failure to establish a complete theoretical evaluation system as a support, but also can not sum up all aspects of constructing “two-oriented society” completely and accurately. Therefore, in view of this problem, calculating the connection degree and identical discrepancy contrary of the Set pair analysis theory (SPA), this paper established the comprehensive evaluation model of “two-oriented society”. Then I used this model to evaluate synthetically and analyze the construction of the Chang-Zhu-Tan Urban Agglomeration “two-oriented society”.

articleTitle: Application and management system development of elite courses
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Elite courses construction is an important part of college infrastructure and instruction reform. The application and management system aims to be an integrated platform including functions of elite courses application, management, and review, which will promote elite courses construction and propel reform to achieve effective combination between paperless management and paper files. In this paper, system's architecture, functional design and implementation process have been focused on. Specially, some technologies about main interface, solution to solve PNG graphics' transparent and PDF file generation have been discussed and carried out in detail.

articleTitle: Design of three high-speed CCD linear image sensor synchronous driving, amplifying and A / D circuit
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: To measure the height of conductor and the stagger of railway overhead contact net, we designed the mobile-type railway contact net geometry measuring equipment based on three high-speed CCD linear image sensors. High-speed CMOS circuit of the CCD logic driver is low-cost, and there is no need to debug. According to the features of TCD1703 chip following measures are taken: (1) CCD output signal is amplified by the summing amplifier, and the output voltage is doubled. (2) using the characteristics of that LED dynamic resistance is small ,we realized non-destructive level shifting. (3) in the circuit, RC compensation circuit was set, eliminating the background level of saw-tooth wave phenomena. Circuit can work stability under the 20 MHZ clock.

articleTitle: An automatic modeling method of team-based organization structure in e-business
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Realization of e-business is based on business process management system (BPMS). In BPMS there are a large number of event logs recording the performers who initiate or complete the activities. Team-based organization structure is so flexible as to be more suitable for the business implementing e-business. However the existing organizational structure modeling methods are difficult to model team-based structure. This paper design an automatic modeling method of team-based organization structure based on event logs from BPMS. Firstly, six kinds of performer relations are analyzed, i.e. PR1-PR6; Secondly, Five kinds of modeling rules are designed, i.e. MR1-MR5; At last, an actual case are given to verify feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Research on the performance-oriented study help system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper is performance-oriented. It introduces what is the study help system, and gives an instruction and definition about the study help system, sums up its function and effect, then classifies the familiar study help systems and analyses them, brings forward four design principles for the study help system as well as its improved ways and its key technologies for development have also been analyzed. Finally, the case based on the help system for PowerPoint is designed. In short, a good study help system is critical in improving the performance of our learning.

articleTitle: Research on the ways of creative network marketing in e-commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In this essay, several ways of marketing in electronic commercial affairs are deeply and easily analyzed. These ways of creative network marketing in electronic commercial affairs such as “cutting down prices in one second:”, “one-yuan auction”, “buying on your behalf;” and “collective buying” are interpreted clearly. Meanwhile the advantages and disadvantages of the ways are also discussed and explored. The author evaluates creative network marketing in electronic commercial affairs in the future consume world.

articleTitle: The analysis of executive ability culture construction in E-government
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: whether the major policies of the Party and country can really be implemented to bring benefits to the people depends on the executive ability. Over a long period of time, serious problems have existed in the sector of enforcement in government departments. Therefore, how to build government's executive ability culture is a new problem before us. Because of the poor government's executive ability, the experience of how to build executive ability culture in enterprises must be used for reference in building an active government's executive ability culture. This article expounds the presenting of executive ability and its connotation, and then lists reasons that cause the reduction of E-government efficiency. Based on this, it concludes that advocating executive ability construction is an effective method to improve E-government efficiency. At last, this article explains some aspects on how to construct executive ability in government.

articleTitle: Probabilistic clustering location data of moving objects in mobile computing environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Data uncertainty is often involved in moving object tracking in mobile computing environment due to reasons such as imprecise measurement or sampling errors. Data mining of such positions of moving objects attracts more and more research interest recently. The definitions of probabilistic core object and probabilistic density-reachability are presented and a probabilistic clustering algorithm for location data of moving objects is proposed, based on DBSCAN algorithm and probabilistic index on moving objects. Experiment results show that the proposed algorithm outperforms other clustering algorithm we knew for moving objects in update rate needed and efficiency of clustering.

articleTitle: Grid security research based on middleware
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Considering OGSA architecture, this paper introduces a new Grid Security System Based on Middleware (GSSBM). The grid includes many different domains; it can make use of middleware technology to implement grid security. Integrating the GSI and PKI technologies, the architecture can solve the single sign-on, authentication, proxy and user-based trust model.

articleTitle: Research on network fault diagnosis based on mobile agent
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Network fault management is an important part of Network management. Aiming to the problem of the traditional SNMP-based network fault management, a mobile agent-based network fault diagnosis model is proposed, which applies mobile agent technology to network management, so it can monitor, detect and deal with network fault autonomously. The structure and function of model, especially the architecture and strategy of diagnostic agent, is depicted. Finally, comparing the system performance through experiment and results show that the network fault diagnosis based on mobile agent has greater advantage.

articleTitle: Design of high speed burst-mode BERT based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Being different from general continual-data stream BER tester, the receiver of burst-mode BER tester is required to extract clock and recover data accurately from the incoming datasteam characterized by phase variation within a dozen bits time before error bits detection is conducted, moreover, while error bits detecting, the receiver should filter the preamble and delimiter and execute error bits statistic only for Payload. In this paper a design method for Burst-mode BER Tester Based on FPGA is put forward. First of all, the whole structure of this design is introduced, and then the logic function modules implemented in the FPGA and system control program are presented in detail separately. The experimental results of applying this test equipment to 1.25 G burst-mode optical receiver in GPON system illustrate that it has good performance and practical value.

articleTitle: Overlay network testing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Lack of testing platform puzzled the research on overlay network. Recent research has shown that researcher can use Distributed Hash Tables (DHTs) to build certain applications, such as scalable, robust and efficient. Unfortunately, even though those applications have been implemented successfully, researcher is also hard to deploy large-scale distributed systems, nor are DHTs. Some worldwide platforms provide publicly accessible DHT service. Those kinds of platforms can issue at least put and get operations to any DHT node, which processes the operations on their behalf in contrast to the usual DHT model. This paper introduces overlay test-platform by an example of testing about resource location and concentrates on how to do the network testing based on it.

articleTitle: Application of digital technology in city guide system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This article analyzes applications and effects of digital technology in city public guide information system; explores the interaction and significance between digital technology and human city public environment. It concludes the digital technology's four characters: precision, intelligentize, interactivity and virtualization in the application of city public guide information system. This article also predicts the future design and applications of digital public guide system.

articleTitle: Truth degree of formula in 4-valued Godel nonlinear lattice logic
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Quantitative logic in the many-valued logic system are established by Guojun Wang, which is based on linear evaluation lattice frame. In this paper, we defined the truth degree of formulas in 4-valued Godel nonlinear lattice logic system, and we given the basic property of the truth degree. Finally, we introduce the concept of the similarity degree between formulas and logic metric space in 4-valued Godel nonlinear lattice logic. It is proved that the new built concepts are extensions of the corresponding concepts in quantified logic.

articleTitle: Method to analyze complex network of knowledge transmission based on trust mechanism
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Because knowledge transmission plays an important role in economic growth, agents often wish to accelerate the flow of knowledge. Marrying a complex network with the small world characteristics, the knowledge transfer takes place through a myopic barter exchange and takes the barter initiative unconditionally in the Cowan model to be amended. The factor that impact the trust and examine knowledge transmission between cognitive-based trust and emotional trust could be analyzed and knowledge transmission model based on trust mechanism of complex network could be introduced. It find that the efficiency of knowledge transmission is high and easy when the trust level is maximal.

articleTitle: A four-factor model on the success of knowledge management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The paper proposes a four-factor model on the success of knowledge management (KM). According to the analysis results, managerial factors are the core components of the model which mainly include coordination, motivation, monitoring and measurement, and technical factors are the critical hardware enabler of KM which can directly determine the effectiveness of KM, just as managerial factors; while external environment factors and internal resource factors develop knowledge gaps under the supervision of managerial factors, and influence KM indirectly by supporting or restricting managerial factors and technical factors.

articleTitle: Game model research on digital company in the dynamic alliance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The rapid progress of information technology and the widely utilization of network technology promote the growth of digital company. For resulting the competitive and cooperated relation among participants in the dynamic alliance of digital company, game model is established, and the game mechanism as while as the game analysis are proposed to clarify the complex relation in the digital network structure. Finally, in the four game models the cooperation-cooperation game model is proved the optimal resolve means.

articleTitle: Gray-fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method apply in the China Coal Construction First Group's risk of the logistics supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Only a simple gray or fuzzy evaluation method can not evaluate the risk of the overall project, objectively and accurately, so use Grey Clustering to get the statistic of gray indicator, construct the fuzzy matrix of project risks, and then establish a risk comprehensive evaluation method, which is a combination of gray and fuzzy matrix. This method can make full use of gray and fuzzy that experts judged the information gray to enable the project risk evaluation is more objective and accurate. This method is applied to the integrated logistics supply chain in the China Coal Construction1First Group and the project risk evaluation results show that this method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: The secrecy evaluation of military enterprises for national defense based on the fuzzy set theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: To eliminate the random and man-made factors of secret censorship evaluation on military enterprises for national defense, standardizing secrecy censorship evaluation, this paper studies the secrecy censorship evaluation of military enterprises for national defense by the fuzzy set theory and method. By designing indexes system of secrecy evaluation and the model of integrated evaluation, quantizing each evaluation index and commentary, analysizing the data acquired, and get the more realistic and scientific secrecy evaluation results, it can provide scientific basis for the secret management.

articleTitle: Empirical study on inter-firm trust and its effect on synergic performance in supply chain:Based on analysis of supply chain node enterprises in Hunan province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: It is very important for the firms in the being formed or already formed supply chain, especially the key firms, to recognize the trust relationship. Based on the literatures, the assumption is proposed by constructing an inter-firm trust model with the samples in the supply chain node enterprises according to a trust measurement table developed newly through Hunan firm background and cultural research. EFA (Exploratory Factor Analysis) is adopted to construct model and CFA (Confirmatory Factor Analysis), to analyze the total reality and validity for the measurements. At the same time, the validity of each latent variable dimension is verified. SEM (Structural Equation Modeling) is used to analyze the relationship among the latent variables, constructing a hypothesis testing, so that guides the domestic firms to implement the SCM (Supply Chain Management) strategy.

articleTitle: A collaborative network office system oriented to web service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper has studied the technology of web service and collaborative mechanism, and designed a set of collaborative network office system by matrix collaborative model. This system has perfectly solved the complex issues about the network data transmission in the course of collaborative working. In accordance with the characteristics of web service and application requirement, the system has designed a unique architecture. The client called by web service communicates with the remote server, achieves lightweight data access to the local XML database operations and a message broadcast mechanism. With its novel design, advanced technique and stable operation, this system has been adopted in many enterprises and government institutions.

articleTitle: Online educational video: Why it could be a huge resource library of educational television in the web 2.0 era
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: With the continuous advancement of network and digit technology, we could produce, transmit and search digital video online easily. The article analyzes online educational video which could be seen as the “long tail phenomenon” of educational television based on the long tail theory. From a technical point of view we evaluate and validate the feasibility which we could consider online educational video as a huge resource library of educational television in order to provide a new perspective of the educational television research in net times.

articleTitle: Research on complexity about a class of complex system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In accordance with the limitation of traditional research on the stock and real estate market, attempt to substitute new research methods and setup for traditional mathematical modeling framework by applying the latest achievements of complexity science and the interdisciplinary approach in the paper. Trying to apply complex adaptive system theory to the stock and real estate market, the system framework of the stock and real estate market based on multi-agent technology is set up, and the key technologies involved were discussed. At first, The internal consistency of the stock and real estate system and complex adaptive system is analyzed, which proves that stock and real estate system is a complex adaptive system. Secondly, a new method of researching on such systems was proposed. Finally, some phenomena occurring in reality system was simulated through the program of Object-c based on swarm. Therefore, the feasibility and validity of applying complexity theory and method to a class of complex adaptive system is verified.

articleTitle: Indicators propose and analysis on national logistics competitive strength
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In the context of international financial crisis and logistics adjustment and revitalization plan, how to enhance national logistics competitive strength has become an urgent problem to be solved for government macro-management department. To enhance national logistics competitive strength, we need to evaluate and keep abreast of status of it. To evaluate national logistics competitive strength, we must build indicators system of it. Therefore, the paper has a study on the definition of national logistics competitive strength, builds indicators system which including four first class indicators and twelve second class indicators to measure it. namely, logistics infrastructure network connectivity; logistics network density, including road network density, railway network density, Airlines network density, inland water transport network density, highway network density, pipeline network density; logistics node size, including logistics park number, port number and warehouses number; Information facility scale, including on-line ratios, telephone penetration. We can have a further research on comparison and evaluation of national logistics competitive strength by this.

articleTitle: Social context for Computer-supported Collaborative Learning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: A technology-mediated learning space is not a technology-shielded island. Technologies may promise to facilitate human learning, but should never detach learning from social context. Computer-mediated communication (CMC) has created new opportunities for synchronous and asynchronous collaborative learning among geographically dispersed individuals. This study especially explores four social considerations in Computer-supported collaborative learning (CSCL), including roles, trust, nimbus, and interpersonal familiarity.

articleTitle: E-retailers'quality-based price discrimination strategies under multiple shipping options
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In e-commerce, shipping is bundled with the purchase of product, which allows e-retailers to create vertical quality differentiation by offering multiple shipping options with some amount of market power, so it is possible for online sellers to use quality-variant of the same basic product to segment the market of heterogeneous consumers. This paper tests quality-based price discrimination model using data on shipping schedules offered by e-retailers. The results indicate that the quality of a slow shipping option is significantly associated with prices of faster shipping options in consistent with prediction of the price discrimination model.

articleTitle: On the computer network information security and related technologies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: on the Information Society that network applications is becoming increasingly popular, information security is the problem that more and more Internet users worry about. Information security involves not only knowledge of Web application security technology, and more related to data encryption technology. This paper describes the network and information security in real-life performance and the specific reasons, and explained the technical aspects of how to improve network information security, including firewalls, encryption, digital signature and digital certification.

articleTitle: Data flow monitoring and control of LAN based on strategy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The data stream visit rule and switches port mirror is defined, and binding relation and strategy of flow control is associated, and the data flow monitoring and control system of LAN is established through the advanced configuration of the third layer switches. The effective control of different data flow in LAN is achieved through strategy control of corresponding ports using Ethereal to capture data packets and analyze flow. The concept of cross entropy is introduced and the relation of network flow and capacity based on cross entropy is put forward to simulate and analyse the influence of the probability of normalized flow in LAN on network performance.

articleTitle: The design of LDPC decoder based on FPGA Programming in C
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: A new design approach of the LDPC decoder based on FPGA Impulse C Programming is proposed. The latest technique of Impulse C programming is used to implement hardware circuit, which is more efficient than the traditional HDL method. The decoder for a family of (3,6) LDPC Codes with 0.5 code rate and the block size of 2500 bits is implemented on Xilinx Virtex2 XC2V2000. When the maximum iteration time is 10 and the frequency is clocked at 50MHz, the throughput is 10 Mbps.

articleTitle: Structure of semantic knowledge database rules-based religious portrait Thangka Image
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The article researches on semantic knowledge base for religious portrait Thangka Images based on rules. Firstly, according to basic semantic content of religious portrait Thangka Images of Mother-Buddha and Bodhisattva etc. adopts unified and structured semantic metadata to describe domain knowledge with the aid of ontology thought. Secondly, obtains basic semantic data by establishing database, chooses key semantic from the metadata to build knowledge base, and uses IF-THEN structure to deposit regular information. At last, with the help of decision tree model, makes use of the forward reasoning way to do deduction to get certain pictures.

articleTitle: Parametric design for the Furniture based on module
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: By using of SolidWorks as the design platform and Visual C++6.0 as the development tool, SolidWorks was redeveloped by API functions. A Parametric Design System for the Furniture was developed by object-oriented tool technology and modular design technology. The system has the function of parametric design and auto-regulation of engineering drawings. It has been proved the design system can improve the design efficiency remarkably.

articleTitle: Logical AND model of variable precision upper approximation operator and grade lower approximation operator
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The paper is to combine precision and grade, and explore new extended rough set model. Based on logical AND requirement of precision and grade, this paper proposes logical AND model of variable precision upper approximation operator and grade lower approximation operator. In the new model, basic structure and properties are obtained, and furthermore regular algorithm and structural algorithm are proposed. The new model has extended classical rough set model partially, and a medical example is given to illustrate it.

articleTitle: A model of education for net generation in modern learning environments
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Flexible time and space, abundant information resource, indirect social interactions and dynamic learning interfaces are main features of modern learning environments. Net generation is accustomed to information-rich environment, Multitasking across multiple “attentional spaces” and collaborative learning. This paper proposes a conceptual educating model which puts forward a multi-dimensional perspective of comprehending possible similarities and differences which could be used to empower teachers to make greater use of technology in the classrooms while addressing the needs of the learners.

articleTitle: The Discussion about the best structural model of knowledge-based librarians under network environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Through the discussion about the characteristic of the network environment and the library under network environment, this passage analyzes the personality characteristics of knowledge-based librarians in the libraries under network environment and presents the best structural model of knowledge-based librarians. And there comes to the conclusion that Only the formation of the best talent structure of knowledge-based librarians can take full advantage of the knowledge-based human resources to maximize their creativity in order to make a coordinated development of entire library system.

articleTitle: Study of robust tracking control for a class of nonlinear systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: A smooth and simple robust tracking controller is presented for a class of nonlinear systems with unmatched uncertainties and a strong relative degree in the paper. Using the technique of feedback linearization and Lyapunov approach, the designed controller can suppress forwardly the influence of uncertainties. Meanwhile, there is no Lyapunov functions in controller but concrete controller expression instead and no norm computing in each step of control. The practical stability of output tracking error and the states of the corresponding closed-loop system are demonstrated by Lyapunov stability theorem. A simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Mobile communication system for chain store operation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: To increase the agility of the chain store operation with the information technology, the communication system is proposed with the mobile networks to link the headquarters with the chain stores distributed widely. In the store, the mobile is attached to POS with USB, and the data exchanging service is developed on the mobile to report the sale data and to download the updated data. At the headquarters, a communication server is established to provide the data service for the mobiles with the customized web service methods. In this way, the sale data of all the chain stores can be gathered in time, which is the groundwork for the business intelligence system.

articleTitle: Network capability and entrepreneurial financing:An empirical study of high-tech new venture
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In order to realize the development, new high-tech firms must find financial support from external organization and venture capital is one way for this purpose. Based on social capital theory, this paper investigates the effect of network capability on entrepreneurial financing by using 368 valid samples of Chinese high-tech firms, and the results show that network capability can facilitate the entrepreneurial financing of the firm. Finally limitations and future research directions are discussed.

articleTitle: The study on multi-user detection based on constant modulus algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper studies the multi-user detection of constant modulus algorithm and presents an application of the new algorithm for constant modulus properties. The algorithm uses the fading channel under the discrete received signal equivalent expressions, which derived by matrix operations lies in the mode value of the minimum conditions, the relationship between the receiver equalizer weights and effective spreading code matrix. Simulation results show that the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Cooperation partners selection for single-core-type MPN
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: On the analytical basis of relevant research in single-core-type modular producing network cooperation partners selecting, considering that partner's quantity, module manufacturing enterprises complementary working ability and main conditions of modular producing network etc. The alternative decision-making model” cooperation partners collection in single-core-type modularize producing network is structured, ascertaining certain quantity “cooperation partners collection ”for per product modularization, and according to the order form to transform the alternative right partners decision-making model is structured to select proper modularization merchant.

articleTitle: Highway passenger traffic volume research based on gray - Markov prediction model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In this paper, we propose the application of gray Markov model for forecasting methods, and amend with the smooth ratio the historical data, establish the GM (1,1) model . By determining the coefficients to obtain the development series of the future road passenger traffic amount, and by combining the Markov chain process, to classify the random sequence status into three categories, by determining the status transfer matrix, we predict the road passenger traffic amount in 5 years. The theoretical analysis and practical application show that the prediction is more reliable using this method. We can manage the development of passenger traffic, which helps the administration to make decisions.

articleTitle: Application research for the information searching system based on Bayesian Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper proposes a solution of filtering garbage information, in order to solve the problem of dynamic delivery of documents. The solution balances the technique of Black and White List Spam Filtering, as well as the advantages and disadvantages of and Bayesian Algorithm. It creates the Bayesian Model based on the analysis of probability distributions of Junk key words, as well as design and implement a set of information filtering system. The system implements information filtering accurately and intelligently.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of search engine on distributed network resources
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Through the research and analysis of search requests to the shared resource on the network, we have designed and implemented a distributed resource search engine that can achieve the following functions: when users search resources on Web, they need only log on a single server and can retrieve the resources exists on multiple servers. Article discusses the background of system design, the main functions of software, getting the state of the server, optimum word segment searching, XML data mode of operation in more detail. System simplifies the process of retrieval of resources, and improves the retrieval efficiency.

articleTitle: A secure communication model of solving anycast scalability in IPv6
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The existing designs for providing anycast services are either to confine each anycast group to a preconfigured topological region or to globally distribute routes to individual anycast group, both of which are all confronted with two problems: scalability and security. A new kind of Anycast communication model is proposed in this paper, which not only solves Anycast existing scalability and security problem but also allows Anycast members to freely leave and join Anycast group. In addition, this model accomplishes the distributed maintenance and transaction of the information on Anycast members so in some sense it fulfills the load balance. This paper deeply analyzes and discusses the feasibility and performance of this communication model, and argues that it is able to support the large-scale Anycast group.

articleTitle: An audio zero-watermarking algorithm based on FFT
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper proposes an audio zero-watermarking algorithm based on Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). This algorithm does not change any contents about the audio signals. It proposes a solution about the contradictions about imperceptible and robustness. The experimental results show this algorithm can effectively resist low-pass filtering, Gaussian noise and re-sampling attacks. This new audio zero-watermarking algorithm based on FFT can meet the requirements of watermarking security.

articleTitle: Replaying lecture recordings on handheld devices
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: With the rapid growth of ubiquitous computing, especially in educational environment, Mobile Learning has emerged as a new type of learning, which utilizes mobile technologies to deliver electronic learning materials to students anywhere and at any time. It can also provide teachers with electronic training solutions. Although many researchers argue that using handheld devices for E-learning activities has high potential, the number of actual applications remains low. This paper proposes a new approach to replaying lecture recordings on Personal Digital Assistant (PDA). A prototype has been designed and implemented. We also conducted a survey on the usability and user acceptance of the prototype, where we compared PDA playback to PC playback. The result shows that PDA is a good candidate as a complementary tool for learning. The prototype fully supports the data format of recorded lectures and is proved to be a stable version to replay lecture recordings.

articleTitle: Industrial-Design-Centered Intellectual Property Strategy of the company
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology and internet technology, the world economy is coming into a Knowledge Economy, and intellectual property is turning into the most important factor of production. This paper proposes a viewpoint of Industrial-Design-Centered Intellectual Property Strategy, and analyses its constituent element and system.
